quote: The number of OTUs in the control group was higher than that in the treatment groups.
statement: 对照组的OTU数量高于处理组。
text_zh: 对照组的OTU数量高于处理组。
text_en: The number of OTUs in the control group was higher than that in the treatment group.

quote: Furthermore, the number of OTUs in the 100 μg/kg AFB1 exposed group was the lowest.
statement: 此外，100 μg/kg AFB1暴露组的OTU数量最低。
text_zh: 此外，100 μg/kg AFB1暴露组的OTU数量最低。
text_en: In addition, the number of OTUs in the 100 μg/kg AFB1 exposure group was the lowest.

quote: The ACE index and Chao1 index were significantly lower in the AFB1 exposed groups than in the control group
statement: 黄曲霉毒素B1暴露组的ACE指数和Chao1指数显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 黄曲霉毒素B1暴露组的ACE指数和Chao1指数显著低于对照组。
text_en: The ACE index and Chao1 index in the aflatoxin B1 exposure group were significantly lower than those in the control group.
outcome: 肠道微生物群落的物种丰富度

quote: Dietary supplementation with probiotics improved immune responses in serum and tissues of fish, as evidenced in previous study with the use B. amyloliquefaciens in L. rohita (Nandi et al., 2017).
statement: 引用先前研究指出，膳食补充益生菌（如L. rohita中的B. amyloliquefaciens）改善了鱼类血清和组织中的免疫反应。
text_zh: 引用先前研究指出，膳食补充益生菌（如L. rohita中的B. amyloliquefaciens）改善了鱼类血清和组织中的免疫反应。
text_en: Citing previous studies, dietary supplementation with probiotics (such as B. amyloliquefaciens in L. rohita) improved immune responses in fish serum and tissues.

quote: Similar results were reported by Yi et al. (2018) found that B. velezensis could activate immune response, which results in an increase of the mRNA expression of IL-10 and IL-4 in the head kidney of C. auratus .
statement: Yi等人(2018)报告称，B. velezensis可激活免疫反应，导致C. auratus头肾中IL-10和IL-4的mRNA表达增加。
text_zh: Yi等人(2018)报告称，B. velezensis可激活免疫反应，导致C. auratus头肾中IL-10和IL-4的mRNA表达增加。
text_en: Yi et al. (2018) reported that B. velezensis can activate immune responses, leading to increased mRNA expression of IL-10 and IL-4 in the head kidney of C. auratus.

quote: Of note, B. velezensis entered into gastrointestinal tract might play a major role in modulation or homeostasis of fish, which could improve the pathogens or opportunistic pathogens clearance by means of B. velezensis carried strongly antagonistic activity against fish pathogens.
statement: 进入胃肠道的B. velezensis可能在调节或维持鱼类稳态方面发挥主要作用，并通过其对鱼病原体的强拮抗活性改善病原体或条件致病菌的清除。
text_zh: 进入胃肠道的B. velezensis可能在调节或维持鱼类稳态方面发挥主要作用，并通过其对鱼病原体的强拮抗活性改善病原体或条件致病菌的清除。
text_en: B. velezensis entering the gastrointestinal tract may play a major role in regulating or maintaining fish homeostasis and improve the clearance of pathogens or opportunistic pathogens through its strong antagonistic activity against fish pathogens.

quote: It is interesting to note that B. velezensis effectively increased TNF-α mRNA expression levels of gut 2 weeks after administration and then down-regulated the expression of TNF-α after 4 weeks.
statement: 值得注意的是，给药2周后B. velezensis有效增加了肠道TNF-α mRNA表达水平，但在4周后下调了TNF-α的表达。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，给药2周后B. velezensis有效增加了肠道TNF-α mRNA表达水平，但在4周后下调了TNF-α的表达。
text_en: It is worth noting that after 2 weeks of administration, B. velezensis effectively increased intestinal TNF-α mRNA expression levels, but downregulated TNF-α expression after 4 weeks.
outcome: 炎症因子时间动态变化

quote: The different modulation effects of probiotics supplementation on TNF-α activity may be related with the bioactivity of the cytokine.
statement: 益生菌补充对TNF-α活性的不同调节效果可能与该细胞因子的生物活性有关。
text_zh: 益生菌补充对TNF-α活性的不同调节效果可能与该细胞因子的生物活性有关。
text_en: The different regulatory effects of probiotic supplementation on TNF-α activity may be related to the biological activity of this cytokine.

quote: We inferred that the pro-inflammatory cytokines may be secreted through the accumulation of macrophage or monocytes in intestine, which could increase the permeability of the intestinal epithelium (Amasheh et al., 2009), the distinct mechanisms merit further research.
statement: 作者推断促炎细胞因子可能通过肠道中巨噬细胞或单核细胞的积累而分泌，这可能会增加肠上皮通透性，具体机制有待进一步研究。
text_zh: 作者推断促炎细胞因子可能通过肠道中巨噬细胞或单核细胞的积累而分泌，这可能会增加肠上皮通透性，具体机制有待进一步研究。
text_en: The authors infer that pro-inflammatory cytokines may be secreted through the accumulation of macrophages or monocytes in the intestine, which may increase intestinal epithelial permeability; the specific mechanism requires further study.
limitations: 机制不明，需进一步研究
counterevidence: 可能增加肠上皮通透性

quote: These compounds are serious contaminants of food, water, aquafeeds, and aquaculture systems, causing health hazards in humans and animals
statement: 黄曲霉毒素是食品、水、水产饲料和水产养殖系统的严重污染物，对人和动物造成健康危害。
text_zh: 黄曲霉毒素是食品、水、水产饲料和水产养殖系统的严重污染物，对人和动物造成健康危害。
text_en: Aflatoxins are serious contaminants of food, water, aquaculture feed, and aquaculture systems, causing health hazards to humans and animals.

quote: Previous studies have reported that AFB1 causes internal organ dysfunction, including induction of hepatotoxicity, teratogenicity, and immunosuppression in fish
statement: 先前的研究报告称，AFB1会导致鱼类内部器官功能障碍，包括诱导肝毒性、致畸性和免疫抑制。
text_zh: 先前的研究报告称，AFB1会导致鱼类内部器官功能障碍，包括诱导肝毒性、致畸性和免疫抑制。
text_en: Previous studies have reported that AFB1 causes dysfunction of internal organs in fish, including inducing hepatotoxicity, teratogenicity, and immunosuppression.

quote: AFB1 exposure could activate oxidative stress and the endoplasmic reticulum stress pathway, inducing apoptosis and inflammation in northern snakehead (Channa argus)
statement: AFB1暴露可激活氧化应激和内质网应激通路，在北方黑鱼（乌鳢）中诱导细胞凋亡和炎症。
text_zh: AFB1暴露可激活氧化应激和内质网应激通路，在北方黑鱼（乌鳢）中诱导细胞凋亡和炎症。
text_en: AFB1 exposure can activate oxidative stress and endoplasmic reticulum stress pathways, inducing apoptosis and inflammation in northern snakehead (Channa argus).

quote: Hepatic and intestinal histopathological damages were found in common carp (Cyprinus carpio) fed with an aflatoxin-contaminated diet
statement: 在喂食受黄曲霉毒素污染的饲料的鲤鱼中发现了肝脏和肠道的组织病理学损伤。
text_zh: 在喂食受黄曲霉毒素污染的饲料的鲤鱼中发现了肝脏和肠道的组织病理学损伤。
text_en: Histopathological damage to the liver and intestine was found in carp fed feed contaminated with aflatoxin.

quote: Dietary aflatoxin B1 could decrease growth performance and damage the structural integrity of immune organs in juvenile grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella)
statement: 日粮中的黄曲霉毒素B1可能会降低草鱼幼鱼的生长性能并损害免疫器官的结构完整性。
text_zh: 日粮中的黄曲霉毒素B1可能会降低草鱼幼鱼的生长性能并损害免疫器官的结构完整性。
text_en: Aflatoxin B1 in the diet may reduce growth performance and impair the structural integrity of immune organs in juvenile grass carp.
outcome: 生长性能与免疫器官结构

quote: Thus, an aflatoxin-contaminated diet may reduce the growth performance of fish and render them more susceptible to opportunistic pathogens frequently found in aquaculture systems
statement: 因此，受黄曲霉毒素污染的饲料可能会降低鱼类的生长性能，并使它们更容易受到水产养殖系统中常见的机会性病原体的侵害。
text_zh: 因此，受黄曲霉毒素污染的饲料可能会降低鱼类的生长性能，并使它们更容易受到水产养殖系统中常见的机会性病原体的侵害。
text_en: Therefore, feed contaminated with aflatoxin may reduce the growth performance of fish and make them more susceptible to opportunistic pathogens common in aquaculture systems.
outcome: 生长性能与疾病易感性

quote: the 50 μg/kg AFB1 and 100 μg/kg AFB1 exposed groups showed significantly higher ROS and MDA levels and significantly lower SOD levels in the liver than those in the control group
statement: 暴露于50 μg/kg和100 μg/kg黄曲霉毒素B1的组别，其肝脏中的ROS和MDA水平显著高于对照组，而SOD水平显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 暴露于50 μg/kg和100 μg/kg黄曲霉毒素B1的组别，其肝脏中的ROS和MDA水平显著高于对照组，而SOD水平显著低于对照组。
text_en: Groups exposed to 50 μg/kg and 100 μg/kg aflatoxin B1 had significantly higher levels of ROS and MDA in the liver than the control group, while SOD levels were significantly lower than those in the control group.

quote: At day 28, the ROS and MDA levels in the 100 μg/kg AFB1 exposed group were about 45% and 189% higher, respectively, and the mean SOD levels in the 100 μg/kg AFB1-exposed group were 45% of the control group.
statement: 在第28天，100 μg/kg黄曲霉毒素B1暴露组的ROS和MDA水平分别比对照组高约45%和189%，且平均SOD水平仅为对照组的45%。
text_zh: 在第28天，100 μg/kg黄曲霉毒素B1暴露组的ROS和MDA水平分别比对照组高约45%和189%，且平均SOD水平仅为对照组的45%。
text_en: On day 28, ROS and MDA levels in the group exposed to 100 μg/kg aflatoxin B1 were about 45% and 189% higher than those in the control group, respectively, and the average SOD level was only 45% of that in the control group.

quote: There were no significant differences between the 50 μg/kg AFB1 and 100 μg/kg AFB1 exposed groups on day 28 (p > 0.05).
statement: 在第28天，50 μg/kg和100 μg/kg黄曲霉毒素B1暴露组之间没有显著差异。
text_zh: 在第28天，50 μg/kg和100 μg/kg黄曲霉毒素B1暴露组之间没有显著差异。
text_en: On day 28, there was no significant difference between the 50 μg/kg and 100 μg/kg aflatoxin B1 exposure groups.

quote: Liver tissue obtained from the AFB1 exposed groups on day 28 showed a lower intensity of red fluorescence (Figure 2 A,B) than the control group, indicating lower GST and CAT levels in hepatocytes.
statement: 第28天从AFB1暴露组获得的肝组织显示出比对照组更低的红色荧光强度，表明肝细胞中GST和CAT水平较低。
text_zh: 第28天从AFB1暴露组获得的肝组织显示出比对照组更低的红色荧光强度，表明肝细胞中GST和CAT水平较低。
text_en: Liver tissue obtained from the AFB1 exposure group on day 28 showed lower red fluorescence intensity than the control group, indicating lower levels of GST and CAT in hepatocytes.

quote: In recent years, CyHV-2 has spread rapidly in many provinces of China and resulted in huge losses for the crucian carp farming industry
statement: 近年来，CyHV-2在中国许多省份迅速传播，给鲫鱼养殖业造成了巨大损失。
text_zh: 近年来，CyHV-2在中国许多省份迅速传播，给鲫鱼养殖业造成了巨大损失。
text_en: In recent years, CyHV-2 has spread rapidly across many provinces in China, causing huge losses to crucian carp farming.

quote: we characterized the defensive capacities of gibel carp exposed to AFB1 and subsequently challenged them with CyHV-2 infection
statement: 本研究表征了暴露于黄曲霉毒素B1（AFB1）后受到CyHV-2感染的银鲫的防御能力。
text_zh: 本研究表征了暴露于黄曲霉毒素B1（AFB1）后受到CyHV-2感染的银鲫的防御能力。
text_en: This study characterized the defense capacity of gibel carp exposed to aflatoxin B1 (AFB1) and subsequently challenged with CyHV-2 infection.

quote: the oxidative stress, gut microbiota, and related gene expression were assessed
statement: 评估了氧化应激、肠道微生物群及相关基因表达以全面评价AFB1对水产养殖的威胁。
text_zh: 评估了氧化应激、肠道微生物群及相关基因表达以全面评价AFB1对水产养殖的威胁。
text_en: Oxidative stress, gut microbiota, and related gene expression were evaluated to comprehensively assess the threat of AFB1 to aquaculture.
outcome: 氧化应激/肠道微生物群/基因表达

quote: The fish were maintained in recirculating aquaria (300 L) for 14 days to acclimatize to laboratory conditions.
statement: 鱼在循环水族箱中饲养14天以适应实验室条件。
text_zh: 鱼在循环水族箱中饲养14天以适应实验室条件。
text_en: Fish were kept in recirculating aquaculture systems for 14 days to acclimate to laboratory conditions.

quote: During the acclimatization period, the fish were fed with commercial feed (Tongwei, Chengdu, China) twice a day, the water temperature was 25 °C ± 1 °C and the water was renewed daily, approximately 30%.
statement: 在驯化期间，每天喂两次商业饲料，水温为25°C±1°C，每天更换约30%的水。
text_zh: 在驯化期间，每天喂两次商业饲料，水温为25°C±1°C，每天更换约30%的水。
text_en: During the acclimation period, commercial feed was provided twice daily, water temperature was maintained at 25°C ± 1°C, and approximately 30% of the water was changed daily.

quote: Probiotics exhibit antagonistic effects to prevent inflammation through competitive adherence to epithelium or mucus (Monica and Warren, 2007).
statement: 益生菌通过竞争性粘附上皮或粘液表现出拮抗作用以防止炎症。
text_zh: 益生菌通过竞争性粘附上皮或粘液表现出拮抗作用以防止炎症。
text_en: Probiotics exhibit antagonistic effects by competitively adhering to epithelium or mucus to prevent inflammation.

quote: A large number of intraepithelial lymphocytes infiltrated the epithelial cells of intestinal villi and significantly promote the growth of intestinal villi after treated with B. subtilis (Tang et al., 2017).
statement: 经枯草芽孢杆菌处理后，大量上皮内淋巴细胞浸润肠绒毛上皮细胞并显著促进肠绒毛生长。
text_zh: 经枯草芽孢杆菌处理后，大量上皮内淋巴细胞浸润肠绒毛上皮细胞并显著促进肠绒毛生长。
text_en: After treatment with Bacillus subtilis, a large number of intraepithelial lymphocytes infiltrated the intestinal villus epithelial cells and significantly promoted intestinal villus growth.
outcome: 肠道形态与免疫细胞浸润

quote: Of particular note, the similar results obtained in this study indicated that few inflammatory cells infiltrated the mucosa in the B. velezensis + A. veronii groups, and numerous goblet cells accumulated in the intestinal villi (Figure 9).
statement: 本研究中获得的类似结果表明，在枯草芽孢杆菌+维氏气单胞菌组中，很少炎性细胞浸润粘膜，且大量杯状细胞积聚在肠绒毛中。
text_zh: 本研究中获得的类似结果表明，在枯草芽孢杆菌+维氏气单胞菌组中，很少炎性细胞浸润粘膜，且大量杯状细胞积聚在肠绒毛中。
text_en: Similar results obtained in this study indicate that in the Bacillus subtilis + Aeromonas veronii group, there was little inflammatory cell infiltration of the mucosa, and a large accumulation of goblet cells in the intestinal villi.
intervention_record: 芽孢杆菌联合维氏气单胞菌
outcome: 肠道炎症反应与杯状细胞数量

quote: The cCAS-STING pathway and the expression of IFN1 was significantly suppressed by AFB1, which might be associated with severe oxidative stress and intestinal microbiota disorder induced by AFB1.
statement: AFB1显著抑制了cCAS-STING通路和IFN1的表达，这可能与AFB1诱导的严重氧化应激和肠道菌群失调有关。
text_zh: AFB1显著抑制了cCAS-STING通路和IFN1的表达，这可能与AFB1诱导的严重氧化应激和肠道菌群失调有关。
text_en: AFB1 significantly inhibited the cCAS-STING pathway and IFN1 expression, which may be related to AFB1-induced severe oxidative stress and gut microbiota dysbiosis.

quote: This research provides new understanding of the threat that AFB1 may increase CyHV-2 susceptibility in C. gibelio .
statement: 该研究提供了关于AFB1可能增加鲤鲫对CyHV-2易感性的威胁的新认识。
text_zh: 该研究提供了关于AFB1可能增加鲤鲫对CyHV-2易感性的威胁的新认识。
text_en: This study provides new insights into the threat that AFB1 may increase the susceptibility of carp and crucian carp to CyHV-2.

quote: At the genus level, the AFB1 exposed groups showed a significantly higher abundance of Aeromonas (p Figure 6 C,D), and a significantly lower abundance of Cetobacterium (p Figure 6 B,E) than the control group.
statement: 在属水平上，与对照组相比，AFB1暴露组的气单胞菌属丰度显著升高，而鲸杆菌属丰度显著降低。
text_zh: 在属水平上，与对照组相比，AFB1暴露组的气单胞菌属丰度显著升高，而鲸杆菌属丰度显著降低。
text_en: At the genus level, compared with the control group, the abundance of Aeromonas in the AFB1 exposure group was significantly increased, while the abundance of Cetobacterium was significantly decreased.

quote: Overall, the PCoA and UPGMA clustering results showed that AFB1 exposure markedly altered the intestinal microbial community structure in gibel carp.
statement: 总体而言，PCoA和UPGMA聚类结果表明，AFB1暴露显著改变了鲫鱼的肠道微生物群落结构。
text_zh: 总体而言，PCoA和UPGMA聚类结果表明，AFB1暴露显著改变了鲫鱼的肠道微生物群落结构。
text_en: Overall, PCoA and UPGMA clustering results indicated that AFB1 exposure significantly altered the gut microbial community structure of crucian carp.

quote: Based on the challenge test, we found that AFB1 exposure increased the mortality of gibelio carp infected with CyHV-2 and enhanced the viral load in liver, kidney and spleen of gibelio carp.
statement: 基于攻毒试验，我们发现AFB1暴露增加了感染CyHV-2的异育银鲫死亡率，并增强了其肝脏、肾脏和脾脏中的病毒载量。
text_zh: 基于攻毒试验，我们发现AFB1暴露增加了感染CyHV-2的异育银鲫死亡率，并增强了其肝脏、肾脏和脾脏中的病毒载量。
text_en: Based on challenge tests, we found that AFB1 exposure increased the mortality of allogynogenetic gibel carp infected with CyHV-2 and enhanced viral loads in their liver, kidney, and spleen.

quote: We believe that AFB1 promoted the amplification of CyHV-2 by inducing the oxidative stress and suppressing the IFN1 response (Figure 9).
statement: 作者认为AFB1通过诱导氧化应激和抑制IFN1反应来促进CyHV-2的扩增。
text_zh: 作者认为AFB1通过诱导氧化应激和抑制IFN1反应来促进CyHV-2的扩增。
text_en: The authors believe that AFB1 promotes CyHV-2 amplification by inducing oxidative stress and inhibiting the IFN1 response.

quote: Similarly, it has been found that azoxystrobin enhance the spring viremia of carp virus (SVCV) replication by regulated the MAPK-Nrf2 signaling pathway to suppress HO-1-mediated IFN expression [ 47 ].
statement: 已有研究发现嘧菌酯通过调节MAPK-Nrf2信号通路抑制HO-1介导的干扰素表达，从而增强鲤春病毒血症病毒（SVCV）的复制。
text_zh: 已有研究发现嘧菌酯通过调节MAPK-Nrf2信号通路抑制HO-1介导的干扰素表达，从而增强鲤春病毒血症病毒（SVCV）的复制。
text_en: Existing research has found that azoxystrobin enhances the replication of Spring Viremia of Carp Virus (SVCV) by inhibiting HO-1-mediated interferon expression through regulation of the MAPK-Nrf2 signaling pathway.

quote: In the present study, the results demonstrated that AFB1 exposure disrupts the intestinal microbiota of gibel carp.
statement: 本研究结果表明，AFB1暴露破坏了鲫鱼的肠道菌群。
text_zh: 本研究结果表明，AFB1暴露破坏了鲫鱼的肠道菌群。
text_en: The results of this study indicate that AFB1 exposure disrupted the gut microbiota of crucian carp.

quote: The PCoA and UPGMA clustering analysis showed that AFB1 exposure markedly altered the intestinal microbial community structure of gibel carp.
statement: PCoA和UPGMA聚类分析显示，AFB1暴露显著改变了鲫鱼的肠道微生物群落结构。
text_zh: PCoA和UPGMA聚类分析显示，AFB1暴露显著改变了鲫鱼的肠道微生物群落结构。
text_en: PCoA and UPGMA cluster analysis showed that AFB1 exposure significantly altered the gut microbial community structure of crucian carp.

quote: The AFB1 exposed groups showed significantly lower richness and diversity of the gut microbiota than the control group.
statement: 与对照组相比，AFB1暴露组的肠道微生物丰富度和多样性显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，AFB1暴露组的肠道微生物丰富度和多样性显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, intestinal microbial richness and diversity in the AFB1 exposure group were significantly reduced.
outcome: 肠道微生物丰富度与多样性

quote: The lower intestinal bacterial richness and diversity reduced the stability of intestinal microbial communities of gibel carp.
statement: 较低的肠道细菌丰富度和多样性降低了鲫鱼肠道微生物群落的稳定性。
text_zh: 较低的肠道细菌丰富度和多样性降低了鲫鱼肠道微生物群落的稳定性。
text_en: Lower intestinal bacterial richness and diversity reduced the stability of the gut microbiota in crucian carp.
outcome: 肠道微生物群落稳定性

quote: Feeding with Clostridium butyricum improved the host immune responses and the survival rate of gibel carp against Carassius auratus herpesvirus (CaHV) infection [ 65 ].
statement: 饲喂丁酸梭菌改善了银鲫的宿主免疫反应，并提高了其抵抗金鱼疱疹病毒感染的存活率。
text_zh: 饲喂丁酸梭菌改善了银鲫的宿主免疫反应，并提高了其抵抗金鱼疱疹病毒感染的存活率。
text_en: Feeding Clostridium butyricum improved the host immune response of gibel carp and increased its survival rate against grass carp hemorrhage virus infection.

quote: Our data demonstrated that the changes in intestinal microbiota caused by AFB1 might weaken the immunity and antioxidant capacity of gibel carp.
statement: 数据表明，由黄曲霉毒素B1引起的肠道菌群变化可能会削弱银鲫的免疫力和抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 数据表明，由黄曲霉毒素B1引起的肠道菌群变化可能会削弱银鲫的免疫力和抗氧化能力。
text_en: Data indicate that gut microbiota changes caused by aflatoxin B1 may weaken the immunity and antioxidant capacity of silver crucian carp.

quote: We found that AFB1 exposure increased the mortality and enhanced the viral load of gibelio carp infected with CyHV-2.
statement: 研究发现，黄曲霉毒素B1暴露增加了感染鲤疱疹病毒II型的银鲫的死亡率并增强了病毒载量。
text_zh: 研究发现，黄曲霉毒素B1暴露增加了感染鲤疱疹病毒II型的银鲫的死亡率并增强了病毒载量。
text_en: The study found that aflatoxin B1 exposure increased mortality and enhanced viral load in gibel carp infected with Cyprinid herpesvirus II.

quote: The AFB1 exposed groups showed a significantly lower Shannon index and a significantly higher Simpson index than the control group
statement: 黄曲霉毒素B1暴露组的Shannon指数显著低于对照组，而Simpson指数显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 黄曲霉毒素B1暴露组的Shannon指数显著低于对照组，而Simpson指数显著高于对照组。
text_en: The Shannon index in the aflatoxin B1 exposure group was significantly lower than that in the control group, while the Simpson index was significantly higher than that in the control group.
outcome: 肠道微生物群落的多样性

quote: The richness and diversity of bacterial communities in the treatment groups were lower than those in control group.
statement: 处理组细菌群落的丰富度和多样性低于对照组。
text_zh: 处理组细菌群落的丰富度和多样性低于对照组。
text_en: The richness and diversity of bacterial communities in the treatment group were lower than those in the control group.

quote: Cd exposure induced ultrastructural alterations in the two gibel carp strains, as shown by the degenerated cristae and swelling of mitochondria.
statement: 镉暴露诱导了两种银鲫品系肝脏线粒体嵴退化和肿胀等超微结构改变。
text_zh: 镉暴露诱导了两种银鲫品系肝脏线粒体嵴退化和肿胀等超微结构改变。
text_en: Cadmium exposure induced ultrastructural changes such as degeneration and swelling of mitochondrial cristae in the livers of two Carassius gibelio strains.
outcome: 肝脏细胞器结构完整性

quote: Meanwhile, irregular parallel stacked endoplasmic reticulum and plaque accumulation within hepatocytes were detected by transmission electron microscopy.
statement: 透射电镜检测到肝细胞内内质网不规则平行堆叠和斑块积累。
text_zh: 透射电镜检测到肝细胞内内质网不规则平行堆叠和斑块积累。
text_en: Transmission electron microscopy detected irregular parallel stacking and plaque accumulation in the endoplasmic reticulum of hepatocytes.
outcome: 肝脏细胞器结构完整性

quote: The results showed that apoptosis signals increased significantly after Cd exposure
statement: 结果显示，镉暴露后凋亡信号显著增加。
text_zh: 结果显示，镉暴露后凋亡信号显著增加。
text_en: The results showed that apoptotic signals increased significantly after cadmium exposure.

quote: taurine supplementation alleviated the ER-stress-induced autophagy and apoptosis after Cd exposure and stimulated antioxidant pathways
statement: 镉暴露后，牛磺酸补充缓解了内质网应激诱导的自噬和凋亡，并刺激了抗氧化途径。
text_zh: 镉暴露后，牛磺酸补充缓解了内质网应激诱导的自噬和凋亡，并刺激了抗氧化途径。
text_en: After cadmium exposure, taurine supplementation alleviated endoplasmic reticulum stress-induced autophagy and apoptosis, and stimulated antioxidant pathways.
outcome: 细胞应激与死亡（自噬、凋亡）及氧化应激

quote: taurine played a protective role in alleviating Cd toxicity through the antioxidant response, ER stress, and autophagy in the F strain
statement: 在F品系中，牛磺酸通过抗氧化反应、内质网应激和自噬在缓解镉毒性方面发挥了保护作用。
text_zh: 在F品系中，牛磺酸通过抗氧化反应、内质网应激和自噬在缓解镉毒性方面发挥了保护作用。
text_en: In the F strain, taurine exerted a protective effect in alleviating cadmium toxicity through antioxidant response, endoplasmic reticulum stress, and autophagy.
outcome: 遗传背景特异性的毒性缓解机制

quote: After the 8-week feeding trial, a challenge test was conducted with fish from each of the four groups by exposing the fish to acute waterborne Cd (11.9 mg/L) (Figure 1 , Phase 2).
statement: 在8周饲养试验后，对四组鱼进行了急性水溶性镉（11.9 mg/L）暴露的挑战测试。
text_zh: 在8周饲养试验后，对四组鱼进行了急性水溶性镉（11.9 mg/L）暴露的挑战测试。
text_en: After an 8-week feeding trial, fish in four groups were subjected to a challenge test with acute water-soluble cadmium (11.9 mg/L) exposure.

quote: Cd exposure was performed in a static aquarium system with continuous aeration for 96 h, with 10 fish per tank and triplicate replicates for each tank.
statement: 镉暴露在静态水族箱系统中进行，持续通气96小时，每缸10条鱼，每个缸设三个重复。
text_zh: 镉暴露在静态水族箱系统中进行，持续通气96小时，每缸10条鱼，每个缸设三个重复。
text_en: Cadmium exposure was conducted in static aquarium systems with continuous aeration for 96 hours, with 10 fish per tank and three replicates per tank.

quote: During the acute exposure experiment, water in the system was refreshed daily.
statement: 在急性暴露实验期间，系统中的水每天更换。
text_zh: 在急性暴露实验期间，系统中的水每天更换。
text_en: During the acute exposure experiment, the water in the system was changed daily.

quote: This experiment was implemented following the guiding principles for the care and use of laboratory animals and was approved by the Institute of Hydrobiology, Chinese Academy of Sciences.
statement: 该实验遵循实验动物护理和使用指导原则实施，并获中国科学院水生生物研究所批准。
text_zh: 该实验遵循实验动物护理和使用指导原则实施，并获中国科学院水生生物研究所批准。
text_en: The experiment was conducted in accordance with the Guidelines for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals and was approved by the Institute of Hydrobiology, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

quote: At the end of the 96 h Cd waterborne experiment, fish were anesthetized with MS-222 solution (Aminobenzoate methanesulfonate, 0.06 g/L, Sigma, St. Louis, MO, USA).
statement: 在96小时镉水暴露实验结束时，鱼用MS-222溶液（氨基苯甲酸甲磺酸盐，0.06 g/L）麻醉。
text_zh: 在96小时镉水暴露实验结束时，鱼用MS-222溶液（氨基苯甲酸甲磺酸盐，0.06 g/L）麻醉。
text_en: At the end of the 96-hour cadmium water exposure experiment, fish were anesthetized with MS-222 solution (tricaine methanesulfonate, 0.06 g/L).

quote: Some members of Proteobacteria and Bacteroidetes are opportunistic pathogens and facilitate inflammation or disrupt the intestinal mucosal barrier [ 58 ].
statement: 变形菌门和拟杆菌门的一些成员是机会性病原体，会促进炎症或破坏肠黏膜屏障。
text_zh: 变形菌门和拟杆菌门的一些成员是机会性病原体，会促进炎症或破坏肠黏膜屏障。
text_en: Some members of the phyla Proteobacteria and Bacteroidetes are opportunistic pathogens that promote inflammation or disrupt the intestinal mucosal barrier.

quote: Fan et al. (2019) showed that increased relative abundance of phylum Proteobacteria in the intestine is associated with slow growth and disease in shrimp [ 59 ].
statement: Fan等人（2019）表明，虾肠道中变形菌门相对丰度的增加与生长缓慢和疾病有关。
text_zh: Fan等人（2019）表明，虾肠道中变形菌门相对丰度的增加与生长缓慢和疾病有关。
text_en: Fan et al. (2019) showed that an increase in the relative abundance of Proteobacteria in shrimp intestines is associated with slow growth and disease.

quote: Previous studies have demonstrated that members of Fusobacteria regulate the transepithelial transport, thus strengthening the mucosal barrier and improving the oxidative and inflammatory status of the intestinal mucosa [ 60 ].
statement: 先前的研究证明，梭杆菌门的成员调节跨上皮转运，从而增强黏膜屏障并改善肠黏膜的氧化和炎症状态。
text_zh: 先前的研究证明，梭杆菌门的成员调节跨上皮转运，从而增强黏膜屏障并改善肠黏膜的氧化和炎症状态。
text_en: Previous studies have demonstrated that members of the phylum Fusobacteriota regulate trans-epithelial transport, thereby enhancing the mucosal barrier and improving the oxidative and inflammatory status of the intestinal mucosa.
outcome: 肠道屏障功能与炎症状态

quote: At the genus level, the abundance of Aeromonas was significantly higher and that of Cetobacterium was significantly lower in the AFB1 exposed groups than in the control group.
statement: 在属水平上，与对照组相比，AFB1暴露组的气单胞菌属丰度显著较高，而鲸杆菌属丰度显著较低。
text_zh: 在属水平上，与对照组相比，AFB1暴露组的气单胞菌属丰度显著较高，而鲸杆菌属丰度显著较低。
text_en: At the genus level, compared with the control group, the abundance of Aeromonas in the AFB1 exposure group was significantly higher, while the abundance of Cetobacterium was significantly lower.

quote: Cadmium is reported to elicit deleterious effects via neurotoxicity, immunotoxicity, induction of oxidative stress, damage to organ structure, and cellular dysfunction
statement: 据报道，镉通过神经毒性、免疫毒性、诱导氧化应激、器官结构损伤和细胞功能障碍产生有害影响。
text_zh: 据报道，镉通过神经毒性、免疫毒性、诱导氧化应激、器官结构损伤和细胞功能障碍产生有害影响。
text_en: It is reported that cadmium produces harmful effects through neurotoxicity, immunotoxicity, induction of oxidative stress, organ structural damage, and cellular dysfunction.

quote: Importantly, oxidative stress and glutathione (GSH) depletion are crucial components of Cd toxicity in aquatic organisms
statement: 重要的是，氧化应激和谷胱甘肽（GSH）耗竭是水生生物中镉毒性的关键组成部分。
text_zh: 重要的是，氧化应激和谷胱甘肽（GSH）耗竭是水生生物中镉毒性的关键组成部分。
text_en: Importantly, oxidative stress and glutathione (GSH) depletion are key components of cadmium toxicity in aquatic organisms.

quote: Therefore, nutrients with antioxidant properties have been applied to ameliorate the hepatotoxicity by modulating antioxidant pathways
statement: 因此，具有抗氧化特性的营养素已被应用于通过调节抗氧化途径来改善肝毒性。
text_zh: 因此，具有抗氧化特性的营养素已被应用于通过调节抗氧化途径来改善肝毒性。
text_en: Therefore, nutrients with antioxidant properties have been applied to improve hepatotoxicity by regulating antioxidant pathways.

quote: The lower SOD levels, and the higher ROS and MDA levels were observed in the AFB1 exposed groups.
statement: 在AFB1暴露组中观察到SOD水平降低，以及ROS和MDA水平升高。
text_zh: 在AFB1暴露组中观察到SOD水平降低，以及ROS和MDA水平升高。
text_en: In the AFB1 exposure group, decreased SOD levels and increased ROS and MDA levels were observed.

quote: These results suggest that AFB1 induces oxidative stress.
statement: 这些结果表明AFB1诱导氧化应激。
text_zh: 这些结果表明AFB1诱导氧化应激。
text_en: These results indicate that AFB1 induces oxidative stress.

quote: Moreover, the oxidative stress increased with the increase in AFB1 concentration.
statement: 此外，氧化应激随AFB1浓度的增加而增加。
text_zh: 此外，氧化应激随AFB1浓度的增加而增加。
text_en: In addition, oxidative stress increased with increasing AFB1 concentration.

quote: Similarly, previous studies have reported that AFB1 significantly reduced the activity of antioxidant enzymes by down-regulating the expression of Nrf2, and increased the levels of ROS and MDA in Nile tilapia [ 45 ] and gibel carp [ 46 ].
statement: 先前的研究报道，AFB1通过下调Nrf2表达显著降低抗氧化酶活性，并增加尼罗罗非鱼和异育银鲫中的ROS和MDA水平。
text_zh: 先前的研究报道，AFB1通过下调Nrf2表达显著降低抗氧化酶活性，并增加尼罗罗非鱼和异育银鲫中的ROS和MDA水平。
text_en: Previous studies reported that AFB1 significantly reduced antioxidant enzyme activity by downregulating Nrf2 expression, and increased ROS and MDA levels in Nile tilapia and gibel carp.

population.species: 尼罗罗非鱼; 异育银鲫

outcome: 抗氧化酶活性及氧化损伤

quote: Previous research showed that ROS accumulation could promote the replication of CyHV-2, while antioxidants could inhibit the amplification of CyHV-2 by activating Nrf2 signaling pathway [ 19 ].
statement: 先前的研究表明，ROS积累可促进CyHV-2复制，而抗氧化剂可通过激活Nrf2信号通路抑制CyHV-2扩增。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，ROS积累可促进CyHV-2复制，而抗氧化剂可通过激活Nrf2信号通路抑制CyHV-2扩增。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that ROS accumulation can promote CyHV-2 replication, while antioxidants can inhibit CyHV-2 amplification by activating the Nrf2 signaling pathway.

quote: Thus, we believe that the oxidative stress induced by AFB1 could promote CyHV-2 proliferation.
statement: 因此，我们认为AFB1诱导的氧化应激可能促进CyHV-2增殖。
text_zh: 因此，我们认为AFB1诱导的氧化应激可能促进CyHV-2增殖。
text_en: Therefore, we believe that AFB1-induced oxidative stress may promote CyHV-2 proliferation.

quote: Our study demonstrated that the expression of caspase-1 was higher, and the expressions of IRF3 and IFN1 were lower, in the AFB1 exposed group.
statement: 我们的研究表明，在AFB1暴露组中，caspase-1表达较高，而IRF3和IFN1表达较低。
text_zh: 我们的研究表明，在AFB1暴露组中，caspase-1表达较高，而IRF3和IFN1表达较低。
text_en: Our study showed that in the AFB1 exposure group, caspase-1 expression was higher, while IRF3 and IFN1 expression were lower.

quote: nutrients with antioxidant properties have been applied to ameliorate the hepatotoxicity by modulating antioxidant pathways, such nutrients include vitamin C, vitamin E, carotenoids, and selenium
statement: 具有抗氧化特性的营养素已被用于通过调节抗氧化途径来改善肝毒性，这些营养素包括维生素C、维生素E、类胡萝卜素和硒。
text_zh: 具有抗氧化特性的营养素已被用于通过调节抗氧化途径来改善肝毒性，这些营养素包括维生素C、维生素E、类胡萝卜素和硒。
text_en: Nutrients with antioxidant properties have been used to improve hepatotoxicity by modulating antioxidant pathways; these nutrients include vitamin C, vitamin E, carotenoids, and selenium.

quote: Nevertheless, the mechanisms underlying the ameliorative effects of taurine against Cd poisoning in teleost fish are still not fully elaborated.
statement: 然而，牛磺酸对硬骨鱼镉中毒的改善作用的潜在机制尚未完全阐明。
text_zh: 然而，牛磺酸对硬骨鱼镉中毒的改善作用的潜在机制尚未完全阐明。
text_en: However, the potential mechanism of taurine's improvement effect on cadmium poisoning in teleost fish has not been fully elucidated.

quote: The cumulative mortality of CyHV-2-infected gibel carp in the control group was 40%, and the cumulative mortality in the T2 group reached 83% at 14 dpi.
statement: 在感染鲤疱疹病毒II型（CyHV-2）的银鲫中，对照组的累积死亡率为40%，而T2组在感染后14天的累积死亡率高达83%。
text_zh: 在感染鲤疱疹病毒II型（CyHV-2）的银鲫中，对照组的累积死亡率为40%，而T2组在感染后14天的累积死亡率高达83%。
text_en: In silver crucian carp infected with Cyprinid herpesvirus II (CyHV-2), the cumulative mortality rate in the control group was 40%, while the cumulative mortality rate in the T2 group reached 83% at 14 days post-infection.

quote: At 14 dpi, the cumulative survival rate of fish exposed to AFB1 was significantly less than in the control group
statement: 在感染后14天，暴露于黄曲霉毒素B1的鱼类的累积存活率显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 在感染后14天，暴露于黄曲霉毒素B1的鱼类的累积存活率显著低于对照组。
text_en: At 14 days post-infection, the cumulative survival rate of fish exposed to aflatoxin B1 was significantly lower than that of the control group.

quote: AFB1 could be a latent threat to the health of aquatic organisms when fishmeal ingredients are replaced with plant-based materials in aquafeeds
statement: 当水产饲料中的鱼粉成分被植物基材料替代时，黄曲霉毒素B1可能对水生生物的健康构成潜在威胁。
text_zh: 当水产饲料中的鱼粉成分被植物基材料替代时，黄曲霉毒素B1可能对水生生物的健康构成潜在威胁。
text_en: When fish meal in aquaculture feed is replaced by plant-based materials, aflatoxin B1 may pose a potential threat to the health of aquatic organisms.

quote: The present study reveals that AFB1 causes oxidative stress, changes in intestinal microbiota and exacerbates CyHV-2 infection in C. gibelio .
statement: 本研究表明，黄曲霉毒素B1导致氧化应激、肠道微生物群改变，并加剧了鲤疱疹病毒II型对银鲫的感染。
text_zh: 本研究表明，黄曲霉毒素B1导致氧化应激、肠道微生物群改变，并加剧了鲤疱疹病毒II型对银鲫的感染。
text_en: This study shows that aflatoxin B1 causes oxidative stress, alters the gut microbiota, and exacerbates Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 infection in gibel carp.
outcome: 氧化应激、肠道微生物群、病毒感染

quote: However, dietary taurine supplementation significantly decreased the feed efficiency (FE) and increased the feed conversion ratio (FCR) in both strains.
statement: 然而，日粮添加牛磺酸显著降低了两种品系的饲料效率并增加了饲料系数。
text_zh: 然而，日粮添加牛磺酸显著降低了两种品系的饲料效率并增加了饲料系数。
text_en: However, dietary taurine supplementation significantly reduced feed efficiency and increased the feed conversion ratio in both strains.

quote: After Cd exposure, no significant variation was observed in the mRNA levels of bach1 , keap1 , nrf2 , or hsp70 among all groups (p > 0.05).
statement: 镉暴露后，各组间bach1、keap1、nrf2或hsp70的mRNA水平未观察到显著变化。
text_zh: 镉暴露后，各组间bach1、keap1、nrf2或hsp70的mRNA水平未观察到显著变化。
text_en: After cadmium exposure, no significant changes were observed in the mRNA levels of bach1, keap1, nrf2 or hsp70 between groups.
outcome: 抗氧化通路及热休克蛋白基因表达

quote: Reports have shown that dietary taurine supplementation could mitigate Cd toxicity in catfish and red sea bream [ 16 , 24 ].
statement: 已有报告表明，日粮补充牛磺酸可以减轻鲶鱼和红海鲷的镉毒性。
text_zh: 已有报告表明，日粮补充牛磺酸可以减轻鲶鱼和红海鲷的镉毒性。
text_en: Reports have indicated that dietary supplementation with taurine can alleviate cadmium toxicity in catfish and red sea bream.

quote: In the present study, histological observations showed that 96 h Cd exposure caused degenerated cristae, swelling of mitochondria, and irregular parallel stacked endoplasmic reticulum, and plaques in the cytoplasm of hepatocytes of both strains, suggesting that Cd damaged the mitochondria and endoplasmic reticulum in the liver cells of gibel carp.
statement: 本研究中，组织学观察显示96小时镉暴露导致两种品系肝细胞线粒体嵴退化、线粒体肿胀、内质网不规则平行堆叠以及细胞质中出现斑块，表明镉损伤了银鲫肝细胞的线粒体和内质网。
text_zh: 本研究中，组织学观察显示96小时镉暴露导致两种品系肝细胞线粒体嵴退化、线粒体肿胀、内质网不规则平行堆叠以及细胞质中出现斑块，表明镉损伤了银鲫肝细胞的线粒体和内质网。
text_en: In this study, histological observations showed that 96-hour cadmium exposure caused degeneration of mitochondrial cristae, mitochondrial swelling, irregular parallel stacking of the endoplasmic reticulum, and the appearance of plaques in the cytoplasm in two strains, indicating that cadmium damaged the mitochondria and endoplasmic reticulum of gibel carp hepatocytes.

quote: Meanwhile, Cd triggered apoptosis signals, as shown by the TUNEL results.
statement: 同时，TUNEL结果显示镉触发了凋亡信号。
text_zh: 同时，TUNEL结果显示镉触发了凋亡信号。
text_en: At the same time, TUNEL results showed that cadmium triggered apoptosis signaling.

quote: Nevertheless, the apoptosis index was significantly lower in both strains fed diets with taurine supplementation compared to the control groups.
statement: 然而，与对照组相比，饲喂添加牛磺酸日粮的两种品系的凋亡指数显著降低。
text_zh: 然而，与对照组相比，饲喂添加牛磺酸日粮的两种品系的凋亡指数显著降低。
text_en: However, compared with the control group, the apoptosis index was significantly reduced in two strains fed taurine-supplemented diets.

quote: Therefore, dietary taurine supplementation could apparently mitigate Cd-induced hepatic damage in gibel carp as in catfish and red sea bream [ 16 , 24 ].
statement: 因此，正如在鲶鱼和红海鲷中所示，日粮补充牛磺酸显然可以减轻银鲫中镉诱导的肝脏损伤。
text_zh: 因此，正如在鲶鱼和红海鲷中所示，日粮补充牛磺酸显然可以减轻银鲫中镉诱导的肝脏损伤。
text_en: Therefore, as shown in catfish and red sea bream, dietary taurine supplementation clearly alleviates cadmium-induced liver damage in silver crucian carp.

quote: In the present study, hepatic mRNA levels of mt increased significantly after Cd exposure, indicating that Cd triggered the protective proteins to counteract the damage to the liver.
statement: 在本研究中，镉暴露后肝脏mt mRNA水平显著增加，表明镉触发了保护性蛋白以抵消对肝脏的损伤。
text_zh: 在本研究中，镉暴露后肝脏mt mRNA水平显著增加，表明镉触发了保护性蛋白以抵消对肝脏的损伤。
text_en: In this study, liver mt mRNA levels increased significantly after cadmium exposure, indicating that cadmium triggered protective proteins to counteract liver damage.

quote: Cd exposure induced significant upregulation of the expression of bax among all groups (p
statement: 镉暴露诱导了所有组中bax表达的显著上调。
text_zh: 镉暴露诱导了所有组中bax表达的显著上调。
text_en: Cadmium exposure induced a significant upregulation of bax expression in all groups.

quote: In the present study, Cd exposure elevated the SOD activity in gibel carp fed the control diet.
statement: 在本研究中，镉暴露提高了饲喂对照饲料的银鲫肝脏超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性。
text_zh: 在本研究中，镉暴露提高了饲喂对照饲料的银鲫肝脏超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性。
text_en: In this study, cadmium exposure increased the liver superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity of gibel carp fed the control diet.

quote: However, no significant differences were found in hepatic SOD activities in fish fed diets with taurine supplementation, implying the protective role of taurine against Cd exposure in gibel carp.
statement: 然而，在饲喂添加牛磺酸饲料的鱼中，肝脏SOD活性未观察到显著差异，这暗示了牛磺酸对银鲫抵抗镉暴露的保护作用。
text_zh: 然而，在饲喂添加牛磺酸饲料的鱼中，肝脏SOD活性未观察到显著差异，这暗示了牛磺酸对银鲫抵抗镉暴露的保护作用。
text_en: However, no significant difference was observed in liver SOD activity in fish fed taurine-supplemented diets, which suggests a protective effect of taurine against cadmium exposure in silver crucian carp.

quote: Dietary taurine supplementation significantly decreased MDA levels in the liver, which is consistent with the results for hepatic SOD activity.
statement: 日粮中添加牛磺酸显著降低了肝脏中的丙二醛（MDA）水平，这与肝脏SOD活性的结果一致。
text_zh: 日粮中添加牛磺酸显著降低了肝脏中的丙二醛（MDA）水平，这与肝脏SOD活性的结果一致。
text_en: Dietary taurine supplementation significantly reduced malondialdehyde (MDA) levels in the liver, which is consistent with the results of liver SOD activity.

quote: Cd exposure suppressed the enzyme activity of CAT in the livers of both strains, but the F strain showed higher levels than the A strain.
statement: 镉暴露抑制了两个品系鱼肝脏中过氧化氢酶（CAT）的酶活性，但F品系的水平高于A品系。
text_zh: 镉暴露抑制了两个品系鱼肝脏中过氧化氢酶（CAT）的酶活性，但F品系的水平高于A品系。
text_en: Cadmium exposure inhibited catalase (CAT) enzyme activity in the livers of two fish strains, but levels were higher in strain F than in strain A.

quote: Moreover, Cd exposure inhibited the activities of T-AOC while elevating the activity of Casp3 and the contents of GSH.
statement: 此外，镉暴露抑制了总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）的活性，同时提高了Casp3活性和谷胱甘肽（GSH）含量。
text_zh: 此外，镉暴露抑制了总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）的活性，同时提高了Casp3活性和谷胱甘肽（GSH）含量。
text_en: In addition, cadmium exposure inhibited the activity of total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC), while increasing Casp3 activity and glutathione (GSH) content.
outcome: 氧化应激与细胞凋亡指标

quote: However, no significant differences were observed in the activities of T-AOC or Casp3 or in the content of GSH in the F strain fed the taurine diet.
statement: 然而，在饲喂牛磺酸饲料的F品系中，T-AOC或Casp3的活性以及GSH的含量未观察到显著差异。
text_zh: 然而，在饲喂牛磺酸饲料的F品系中，T-AOC或Casp3的活性以及GSH的含量未观察到显著差异。
text_en: However, in the F strain fed taurine-supplemented feed, no significant difference was observed in T-AOC or Casp3 activity or GSH content.
outcome: 氧化应激与细胞凋亡指标

quote: Additionally, even though the activity of GSH-Px showed no variation among groups, the lowest level was found in the F strain fed the diet with taurine
statement: 此外，尽管谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GSH-Px）的活性在各组间没有变化，但在饲喂含牛磺酸饲料的F品系中发现了最低水平。
text_zh: 此外，尽管谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GSH-Px）的活性在各组间没有变化，但在饲喂含牛磺酸饲料的F品系中发现了最低水平。
text_en: In addition, although glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px) activity did not change among the groups, the lowest level was found in the F strain fed taurine-supplemented diets.

quote: even though the activity of GSH-Px showed no variation among groups, the lowest level was found in the F strain fed the diet with taurine supplementation
statement: 尽管各组间GSH-Px活性无变化，但在饲喂补充牛磺酸日粮的F品系中发现了最低水平。
text_zh: 尽管各组间GSH-Px活性无变化，但在饲喂补充牛磺酸日粮的F品系中发现了最低水平。
text_en: Although there was no change in GSH-Px activity between groups, the lowest level was found in the F strain fed the taurine-supplemented diet.

quote: Overall, taurine may exert its protective function against Cd poisoning more efficiently in the F strain than in the A strain.
statement: 总体而言，牛磺酸对F品系的镉中毒保护功能可能比A品系更有效。
text_zh: 总体而言，牛磺酸对F品系的镉中毒保护功能可能比A品系更有效。
text_en: Overall, the protective function of taurine against cadmium poisoning may be more effective in the F strain than in the A strain.

quote: In the present study, the nrf2 signaling pathway was activated, as indicated by upregulation of nrf2 mRNA levels in both strains fed the taurine supplemented diet.
statement: 在本研究中，nrf2信号通路被激活，表现为饲喂补充牛磺酸日粮的两个品系中nrf2 mRNA水平上调。
text_zh: 在本研究中，nrf2信号通路被激活，表现为饲喂补充牛磺酸日粮的两个品系中nrf2 mRNA水平上调。
text_en: In this study, the nrf2 signaling pathway was activated, as evidenced by upregulated nrf2 mRNA levels in two strains fed taurine-supplemented diets.
outcome: 氧化应激相关基因表达

quote: Before Cd exposure, the expression levels of nrf2 and bach1 were significantly higher in both strains fed diets with taurine supplementation than in the control groups, indicating that dietary taurine could enhance the antioxidant potential of gibel carp
statement: 在镉暴露前，饲喂补充牛磺酸日粮的两个品系中nrf2和bach1的表达水平显著高于对照组，表明膳食牛磺酸可以增强鲫鱼的抗氧化潜力。
text_zh: 在镉暴露前，饲喂补充牛磺酸日粮的两个品系中nrf2和bach1的表达水平显著高于对照组，表明膳食牛磺酸可以增强鲫鱼的抗氧化潜力。
text_en: Before cadmium exposure, the expression levels of nrf2 and bach1 in two strains fed taurine-supplemented diets were significantly higher than those in the control group, indicating that dietary taurine can enhance the antioxidant potential of crucian carp.

quote: while such beneficial effects were not observed after the Cd exposure.
statement: 而在镉暴露后未观察到这种有益效果。
text_zh: 而在镉暴露后未观察到这种有益效果。
text_en: However, this beneficial effect was not observed after cadmium exposure.

quote: Previous studies had indicated that Cd waterborne could induce ER stress in both strains of gibel carp [ 25 ].
statement: 先前的研究表明，水中的镉（Cd）可诱导两种品系的鲫鱼产生内质网应激。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，水中的镉（Cd）可诱导两种品系的鲫鱼产生内质网应激。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that cadmium (Cd) in water can induce endoplasmic reticulum stress in two strains of crucian carp.

quote: In the present study, the expression levels of the ER-stress-related genes ire1 , perk , atf6 , xbp1 , eif2α , and atf4 were increased after Cd exposure.
statement: 在本研究中，镉暴露后内质网应激相关基因ire1、perk、atf6、xbp1、eif2α和atf4的表达水平升高。
text_zh: 在本研究中，镉暴露后内质网应激相关基因ire1、perk、atf6、xbp1、eif2α和atf4的表达水平升高。
text_en: In this study, the expression levels of endoplasmic reticulum stress-related genes ire1, perk, atf6, xbp1, eif2α and atf4 increased after cadmium exposure.
outcome: 分子生物学指标/应激反应

quote: Meanwhile, hepatic histological alterations such as swelling of mitochondria and irregular parallel stacks of ER were triggered by Cd exposure, observations that confirmed the ER stress in gibel carp.
statement: 同时，镉暴露引发了线粒体肿胀和内质网不规则平行堆叠等肝脏组织学改变，这些观察结果证实了鲫鱼的内质网应激。
text_zh: 同时，镉暴露引发了线粒体肿胀和内质网不规则平行堆叠等肝脏组织学改变，这些观察结果证实了鲫鱼的内质网应激。
text_en: At the same time, cadmium exposure induced histological changes in the liver such as mitochondrial swelling and irregular parallel stacking of the endoplasmic reticulum; these observations confirmed endoplasmic reticulum stress in crucian carp.

quote: It has been reported that Cd exposure could cause such a stress response, eliciting ER-stress-mediated autophagic and apoptosis processes in both strains of gibel carp
statement: 据报道，镉暴露可引起这种应激反应，从而在两种品系的鲫鱼中引发由内质网应激介导的自噬和凋亡过程。
text_zh: 据报道，镉暴露可引起这种应激反应，从而在两种品系的鲫鱼中引发由内质网应激介导的自噬和凋亡过程。
text_en: It is reported that cadmium exposure can induce this stress response, thereby triggering endoplasmic reticulum stress-mediated autophagy and apoptosis in two strains of crucian carp.

quote: The mRNA levels of bax increased after Cd exposure in all groups, but unaltered mRNA levels of bax were found in the A strain fed taurine, implying that dietary taurine supplementation alleviated the Cd toxicity by attenuating apoptosis in the A strain compared to the F strain.
statement: 饲喂牛磺酸使A品系在镉暴露后bax mRNA水平保持不变，表明膳食牛磺酸补充通过减弱细胞凋亡缓解了A品系相对于F品系的镉毒性。
text_zh: 饲喂牛磺酸使A品系在镉暴露后bax mRNA水平保持不变，表明膳食牛磺酸补充通过减弱细胞凋亡缓解了A品系相对于F品系的镉毒性。
text_en: Feeding taurine kept bax mRNA levels unchanged in the A strain after cadmium exposure, indicating that dietary taurine supplementation alleviated cadmium toxicity in the A strain relative to the F strain by attenuating apoptosis.
outcome: 镉毒性缓解与细胞凋亡

quote: Expression levels of genes involved in antioxidant response, ER stress, and autophagy in the F strain post Cd exposure was not in cluster with other treatments, especially in the F strain fed the taurine diet, which was in line with previous results.
statement: F品系在镉暴露后涉及抗氧化反应、内质网应激和自噬的基因表达水平未与其他处理聚为一类，特别是饲喂牛磺酸日粮的F品系，这与之前的结果一致。
text_zh: F品系在镉暴露后涉及抗氧化反应、内质网应激和自噬的基因表达水平未与其他处理聚为一类，特别是饲喂牛磺酸日粮的F品系，这与之前的结果一致。
text_en: The gene expression levels involved in antioxidant response, endoplasmic reticulum stress, and autophagy in the F strain after cadmium exposure did not cluster with other treatments, particularly in the F strain fed a taurine diet, which is consistent with previous results.
outcome: 抗氧化、内质网应激及自噬相关基因表达

quote: In the present study, even the growth performance was not significantly improved by dietary taurine supplement, but the detoxication of taurine might help to increase the survival rate of fish and raise fish quality, thereby improving the economic benefits.
statement: 在本研究中，尽管膳食牛磺酸补充并未显著改善生长性能，但牛磺酸的解毒作用可能有助于提高鱼的存活率并提升鱼的品质，从而改善经济效益。
text_zh: 在本研究中，尽管膳食牛磺酸补充并未显著改善生长性能，但牛磺酸的解毒作用可能有助于提高鱼的存活率并提升鱼的品质，从而改善经济效益。
text_en: In this study, although dietary taurine supplementation did not significantly improve growth performance, the detoxification effect of taurine may help increase fish survival rates and improve fish quality, thereby enhancing economic benefits.
outcome: 生长性能、存活率与品质
counterevidence: growth performance was not significantly improved

quote: Dietary taurine supplementation had no significant effect on the growth performance of gibel carp but did alleviate the Cd toxicity in both strains via specific genetic pathways.
statement: 饲料中添加牛磺酸对银鲫的生长性能没有显著影响，但通过特定的遗传途径减轻了两种品系的镉毒性。
text_zh: 饲料中添加牛磺酸对银鲫的生长性能没有显著影响，但通过特定的遗传途径减轻了两种品系的镉毒性。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with taurine had no significant effect on the growth performance of silver crucian carp, but mitigated cadmium toxicity in two strains through specific genetic pathways.
outcome: 生长性能与镉毒性缓解
counterevidence: 对生长性能无显著影响

quote: Dietary taurine played a protective role in mitigating Cd toxicity in the F strain through the antioxidant response, ER stress response, and autophagy, while in the A strain taurine alleviated cadmium toxicity by attenuation of apoptosis.
statement: 饲料中的牛磺酸在F品系中通过抗氧化反应、内质网应激反应和自噬作用发挥保护性作用以减轻镉毒性，而在A品系中则通过减弱细胞凋亡来缓解镉毒性。
text_zh: 饲料中的牛磺酸在F品系中通过抗氧化反应、内质网应激反应和自噬作用发挥保护性作用以减轻镉毒性，而在A品系中则通过减弱细胞凋亡来缓解镉毒性。
text_en: Taurine in feed exerts protective effects against cadmium toxicity in the F strain through antioxidant response, endoplasmic reticulum stress response, and autophagy, while in the A strain it alleviates cadmium toxicity by reducing apoptosis.
outcome: 镉毒性缓解机制（氧化应激、内质网应激、自噬、凋亡）

quote: In conclusion, the present study has provided evidence for the use of taurine in intervention or therapy for Cd poisoning in fish; thus, providing useful information for selective breeding in aquaculture.
statement: 本研究为使用牛磺酸干预或治疗鱼类镉中毒提供了证据，从而为水产养殖中的选育提供了有用信息。
text_zh: 本研究为使用牛磺酸干预或治疗鱼类镉中毒提供了证据，从而为水产养殖中的选育提供了有用信息。
text_en: This study provides evidence for the use of taurine intervention or treatment for cadmium poisoning in fish, thereby providing useful information for selective breeding in aquaculture.

quote: Molecular expression of genes involved in antioxidant response, ER stress, and autophagy in the F strain after Cd exposure was not in a cluster with other treatments, especially in the F strain fed the taurine diet.
statement: F品系在镉暴露后涉及抗氧化反应、内质网应激和自噬的基因分子表达未与其他处理聚为一类，特别是在饲喂牛磺酸日粮的F品系中。
text_zh: F品系在镉暴露后涉及抗氧化反应、内质网应激和自噬的基因分子表达未与其他处理聚为一类，特别是在饲喂牛磺酸日粮的F品系中。
text_en: The gene molecular expression involving antioxidant response, endoplasmic reticulum stress and autophagy in the F strain after cadmium exposure did not cluster with other treatments, particularly in the F strain fed a taurine diet.
outcome: 抗氧化反应、内质网应激和自噬相关基因表达

quote: Dietary taurine supplementation significantly decreased FE and increased FCR in both strains.
statement: 日粮牛磺酸补充显著降低了两个品系的摄食量并增加了饲料系数。
text_zh: 日粮牛磺酸补充显著降低了两个品系的摄食量并增加了饲料系数。
text_en: Dietary taurine supplementation significantly reduced feed intake and increased the feed conversion ratio in two strains.

quote: When the dietary taurine level exceeds the basic nutritional requirement, this can lead to feed intake reduction, as has been reported in Nile tilapia [ 33 ].
statement: 当日粮牛磺酸水平超过基本营养需求时，这可能导致采食量减少，这在尼罗罗非鱼中已有报道。
text_zh: 当日粮牛磺酸水平超过基本营养需求时，这可能导致采食量减少，这在尼罗罗非鱼中已有报道。
text_en: When dietary taurine levels exceed basic nutritional requirements, this may lead to reduced feed intake, which has been reported in Nile tilapia.

quote: Therefore, the effects of dietary taurine supplement on growth of aquatic animals may be dose or time dependent.
statement: 因此，日粮牛磺酸补充对水生动物生长的影响可能取决于剂量或时间。
text_zh: 因此，日粮牛磺酸补充对水生动物生长的影响可能取决于剂量或时间。
text_en: Therefore, the effect of dietary taurine supplementation on the growth of aquatic animals may depend on dose or time.

quote: Before Cd exposure, the enzyme activities of T-AOC, SOD, GSH-Px, Casp3, and contents of GSH showed no significant variation among treatments (Figure 5).
statement: 在镉暴露前，各处理组之间的T-AOC、SOD、GSH-Px、Casp3酶活性及GSH含量无显著差异。
text_zh: 在镉暴露前，各处理组之间的T-AOC、SOD、GSH-Px、Casp3酶活性及GSH含量无显著差异。
text_en: Before cadmium exposure, there was no significant difference in T-AOC, SOD, GSH-Px, and Casp3 enzyme activities or GSH content among the treatment groups.
outcome: 抗氧化酶活性与凋亡指标

quote: Dietary taurine supplementation significantly enhanced the activities of CAT in the A strain compared to other groups (p p p Figure 5 Antioxidant indices and Casp3 activity in the livers of gibel carp (A and F strains) before cadmium exposure (white bars) and after cadmium exposure (black bars).
statement: 与其他组相比，饲料中添加牛磺酸显著提高了A品系鲫鱼的CAT活性。
text_zh: 与其他组相比，饲料中添加牛磺酸显著提高了A品系鲫鱼的CAT活性。
text_en: Compared with other groups, taurine supplementation in the feed significantly increased CAT activity in A-line crucian carp.

quote: Cd exposure significantly inhibited the activities of CAT in both strains of gibel carp and reduced the content of MDA in the F strain.
statement: 镉暴露显著抑制了两种品系鲫鱼的CAT活性，并降低了F品系的MDA含量。
text_zh: 镉暴露显著抑制了两种品系鲫鱼的CAT活性，并降低了F品系的MDA含量。
text_en: Cadmium exposure significantly inhibited CAT activity in two strains of crucian carp and reduced MDA content in the F strain.

quote: For both gibel carp strains, Cd exposure suppressed the activity of T-AOC, whereas the activity of Casp3 and the contents of GSH were elevated.
statement: 对于两种品系的鲫鱼，镉暴露均抑制了T-AOC活性，而Casp3活性和GSH含量升高。
text_zh: 对于两种品系的鲫鱼，镉暴露均抑制了T-AOC活性，而Casp3活性和GSH含量升高。
text_en: For two strains of crucian carp, cadmium exposure inhibited T-AOC activity, while Casp3 activity and GSH content increased.
outcome: 总抗氧化能力及细胞凋亡

quote: However, the F strain fed the diet with taurine supplementation did not show significant differences in the activities of T-AOC or Casp3 or in GSH content.
statement: 然而，饲喂含牛磺酸日粮的F品系在T-AOC或Casp3活性以及GSH含量方面未显示显著差异。
text_zh: 然而，饲喂含牛磺酸日粮的F品系在T-AOC或Casp3活性以及GSH含量方面未显示显著差异。
text_en: However, the F strain fed taurine-containing diets showed no significant difference in T-AOC or Casp3 activity and GSH content.
outcome: 抗氧化酶活性与凋亡指标

quote: Among all groups, only the F strain given dietary taurine supplementation showed significant reduction in the activity of GSH-Px (p 3.4. Antioxidant Pathways and Metallothionein Levels The expression levels of antioxidant genes and metallothionein are shown in Figure 6 .
statement: 在所有组中，只有给予饲料牛磺酸补充的F品系显示出GSH-Px活性的显著降低。
text_zh: 在所有组中，只有给予饲料牛磺酸补充的F品系显示出GSH-Px活性的显著降低。
text_en: Among all groups, only the F strain given dietary taurine supplementation showed a significant decrease in GSH-Px activity.

quote: BA powder was used for the supplements at a concentration of 0, 200, 400, 600, and 800 mg/kg (named as BA0, BA200, BA400, BA600, and BA800, respectively).
statement: 胆汁酸（BA）粉末作为补充剂，添加浓度分别为0、200、400、600和800 mg/kg。
text_zh: 胆汁酸（BA）粉末作为补充剂，添加浓度分别为0、200、400、600和800 mg/kg。
text_en: Bile acid (BA) powder was used as a supplement, added at concentrations of 0, 200, 400, 600 and 800 mg/kg.

quote: the continuous overconsumption of dietary fat or misuse of a high-fat diet (HFD) would increase the risk of hepatic steatosis, fatty liver, and other metabolic dysfunction in fish, thereby compromising the growth, health, and quality of aquatic products
statement: 持续过量摄入膳食脂肪或滥用高脂饮食会增加鱼类肝脂肪变性、脂肪肝和其他代谢功能障碍的风险，从而损害水产品的生长、健康和质量。
text_zh: 持续过量摄入膳食脂肪或滥用高脂饮食会增加鱼类肝脂肪变性、脂肪肝和其他代谢功能障碍的风险，从而损害水产品的生长、健康和质量。
text_en: Continuous excessive intake of dietary fat or abuse of a high-fat diet increases the risk of hepatic steatosis, fatty liver, and other metabolic dysfunctions in fish, thereby impairing the growth, health, and quality of aquatic products.

quote: developing a feed additive to mitigate lipid metabolism disorder and the related adverse effects in aquatic animals, particularly in the core metabolic organ, the liver, is a priority.
statement: 开发一种饲料添加剂以减轻水生动物（特别是核心代谢器官肝脏）的脂质代谢紊乱及相关不良反应是当务之急。
text_zh: 开发一种饲料添加剂以减轻水生动物（特别是核心代谢器官肝脏）的脂质代谢紊乱及相关不良反应是当务之急。
text_en: It is a priority to develop a feed additive to alleviate lipid metabolism disorders and related adverse reactions in aquatic animals (especially the liver, a core metabolic organ).

quote: Based on the overall biochemical, morphological, and transcriptional alterations, the BA-induced mitigation effect on liver damage in HFD-fed gibel carp is more marked in fish receiving 600 mg/kg dietary BA than in those in other groups.
statement: 根据整体生化、形态学和转录组变化，在喂食高脂饲料的银鲫中，600 mg/kg膳食BA对肝损伤的缓解作用比其他组更显著。
text_zh: 根据整体生化、形态学和转录组变化，在喂食高脂饲料的银鲫中，600 mg/kg膳食BA对肝损伤的缓解作用比其他组更显著。
text_en: Based on overall biochemical, morphological and transcriptomic changes, the alleviating effect of dietary BA at 600 mg/kg on liver injury in silver crucian carp fed high-fat diets was more significant than that in other groups.

quote: this study aimed to investigate the influence of dietary BAs with five different contents on biochemical responses, hepatopancreas histology, lipid metabolism-related gene expression, and transcriptomic characteristics in HFD-fed gibel carp using CAS III.
statement: 本研究旨在探讨日粮中添加五种不同含量的胆汁酸（BA）对高脂饲料喂养的银鲫生化反应、肝胰腺组织学、脂质代谢相关基因表达及转录组特征的影响。
text_zh: 本研究旨在探讨日粮中添加五种不同含量的胆汁酸（BA）对高脂饲料喂养的银鲫生化反应、肝胰腺组织学、脂质代谢相关基因表达及转录组特征的影响。
text_en: This study aimed to investigate the effects of dietary supplementation with five different levels of bile acids (BA) on biochemical responses, hepatopancreas histology, expression of lipid metabolism-related genes, and transcriptomic characteristics in gibel carp fed a high-fat diet.

quote: Our results would benefit the further utilization of exogenous BAs as feed additives in gibel carp, which may also offer guidance for developing low-cost, efficient, and environmentally friendly compound feed for gibel carp, alongside ameliorating lipid metabolism-associated issues in HFD-fed gibel carp and other fish species.
statement: 研究结果将有助于外源胆汁酸作为银鲫饲料添加剂的进一步利用，并可能为开发低成本、高效且环保的银鲫配合饲料提供指导，同时改善高脂饲料喂养的银鲫及其他鱼类的脂质代谢相关问题。
text_zh: 研究结果将有助于外源胆汁酸作为银鲫饲料添加剂的进一步利用，并可能为开发低成本、高效且环保的银鲫配合饲料提供指导，同时改善高脂饲料喂养的银鲫及其他鱼类的脂质代谢相关问题。
text_en: The results will help further utilize exogenous bile acids as feed additives for gibel carp, and may provide guidance for developing low-cost, high-efficiency, and environmentally friendly formulated feeds for gibel carp, while improving lipid metabolism-related issues in gibel carp and other fish fed high-fat diets.

quote: Five isonitrogenous (35% crude protein) and isolipidic (12% crude fat) diets were prepared to contain graded levels of bile acid (BA)... BA powder was used for the supplements at a concentration of 0, 200, 400, 600, and 800 mg/kg
statement: 制备了五种等氮（35%粗蛋白）和等脂（12%粗脂肪）的日粮，其中含有梯度水平的胆汁酸（BA），补充浓度分别为0、200、400、600和800 mg/kg。
text_zh: 制备了五种等氮（35%粗蛋白）和等脂（12%粗脂肪）的日粮，其中含有梯度水平的胆汁酸（BA），补充浓度分别为0、200、400、600和800 mg/kg。
text_en: Five iso-nitrogenous (35% crude protein) and iso-lipidic (12% crude fat) diets were prepared, containing gradient levels of bile acids (BA), with supplementation concentrations of 0, 200, 400, 600, and 800 mg/kg.

quote: Therefore, four groups of fish were obtained: the A strain fed the control diet (A0), the A strain fed a 1% TAU supplemented diet (A1), the F strain fed the control diet (F0), and the F strain fed a 1% TAU supplemented diet (F1).
statement: 实验设置了四个组：A品系饲喂对照饲料（A0）、A品系饲喂添加1%牛磺酸的饲料（A1）、F品系饲喂对照饲料（F0）以及F品系饲喂添加1%牛磺酸的饲料（F1）。
text_zh: 实验设置了四个组：A品系饲喂对照饲料（A0）、A品系饲喂添加1%牛磺酸的饲料（A1）、F品系饲喂对照饲料（F0）以及F品系饲喂添加1%牛磺酸的饲料（F1）。
text_en: The experiment set up four groups: Strain A fed the control diet (A0), Strain A fed a diet supplemented with 1% taurine (A1), Strain F fed the control diet (F0), and Strain F fed a diet supplemented with 1% taurine (F1).

quote: long-term HFD feeding can impair growth and health in fish
statement: 长期高脂饮食喂养会损害鱼类的生长和健康。
text_zh: 长期高脂饮食喂养会损害鱼类的生长和健康。
text_en: Long-term high-fat diet feeding damages the growth and health of fish.

quote: Bile acids (BAs), as feed additives, have been reported to alleviate the HFD-induced metabolic disorders in fish.
statement: 据报道，作为饲料添加剂的胆汁酸可以缓解鱼类由高脂饮食引起的代谢紊乱。
text_zh: 据报道，作为饲料添加剂的胆汁酸可以缓解鱼类由高脂饮食引起的代谢紊乱。
text_en: It is reported that bile acids as feed additives can alleviate metabolic disorders in fish caused by high-fat diets.

quote: Fish fed on diets with 400–600 mg/kg BA exhibited obviously lower contents of aspartate transaminase, alanine aminotransferase, low-density lipoprotein, triglyceride, and total cholesterol, which was accompanied by the relief of liver pathological injury.
statement: 饲喂含400-600毫克/千克胆汁酸的饲料的鱼表现出天冬氨酸转氨酶、丙氨酸转氨酶、低密度脂蛋白、甘油三酯和总胆固醇含量明显降低，并伴有肝脏病理损伤的缓解。
text_zh: 饲喂含400-600毫克/千克胆汁酸的饲料的鱼表现出天冬氨酸转氨酶、丙氨酸转氨酶、低密度脂蛋白、甘油三酯和总胆固醇含量明显降低，并伴有肝脏病理损伤的缓解。
text_en: Fish fed a diet containing 400-600 mg/kg bile acids showed significantly decreased levels of aspartate aminotransferase, alanine aminotransferase, low-density lipoprotein, triglycerides, and total cholesterol, accompanied by alleviation of liver pathological damage.

quote: The uneaten food and feces were removed by siphoning when observing feed remained after 45–60 min of feeding.
statement: 当观察到投喂后45-60分钟仍有剩余饲料时，通过虹吸法清除未食用的食物和粪便。
text_zh: 当观察到投喂后45-60分钟仍有剩余饲料时，通过虹吸法清除未食用的食物和粪便。
text_en: When leftover feed is observed 45-60 minutes after feeding, remove uneaten food and feces by siphoning.

quote: The fasted individuals were anesthetized with 20 mg/L MS-222 (Merck KgaA, Darmstadt, Germany).
statement: 禁食的个体使用20 mg/L的MS-222进行麻醉。
text_zh: 禁食的个体使用20 mg/L的MS-222进行麻醉。
text_en: Fasted individuals were anesthetized with 20 mg/L of MS-222.

quote: The adverse effects induced by HFD feeding have been evidenced in many fish [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 20 ], including gibel carp and other cyprinid fishes, particularly under intensive aquaculture conditions.
statement: 高脂饲料（HFD）喂养已在许多鱼类中证实会产生不利影响，包括异育银鲫和其他鲤科鱼类，特别是在集约化养殖条件下。
text_zh: 高脂饲料（HFD）喂养已在许多鱼类中证实会产生不利影响，包括异育银鲫和其他鲤科鱼类，特别是在集约化养殖条件下。
text_en: High-fat diet (HFD) feeding has been confirmed to produce adverse effects in many fish species, including allogynogenetic gibel carp and other cyprinid fish, particularly under intensive farming conditions.

population.species: 异育银鲫 (Gibel carp) / 鲤科鱼类

quote: Functional/nutritional additives in aquafeeds have been demonstrated to be a viable approach to palliating HFD-induced metabolic and growth disturbances, thereby improving various aspects of fish farming [ 9 , 12 , 20 , 21 ].
statement: 水产饲料中的功能性/营养添加剂已被证明是缓解高脂饲料引起的代谢和生长紊乱的一种可行方法，从而改善水产养殖的各个方面。
text_zh: 水产饲料中的功能性/营养添加剂已被证明是缓解高脂饲料引起的代谢和生长紊乱的一种可行方法，从而改善水产养殖的各个方面。
text_en: Functional/nutritional additives in aquaculture feed have been proven to be a viable method for alleviating metabolic and growth disorders caused by high-fat diets, thereby improving various aspects of aquaculture.

quote: A study has reported that the suitable concentration and the tolerated concentration of dietary BA were 60 mg/kg and 600 mg/kg for common carp fed on diets with low dietary lipid content, respectively [ 17 ].
statement: 一项研究报告称，对于低脂饮食喂养的鲤鱼，日粮中胆汁酸（BA）的适宜浓度和耐受浓度分别为60 mg/kg和600 mg/kg。
text_zh: 一项研究报告称，对于低脂饮食喂养的鲤鱼，日粮中胆汁酸（BA）的适宜浓度和耐受浓度分别为60 mg/kg和600 mg/kg。
text_en: A study reported that for carp fed a low-fat diet, the appropriate and tolerable concentrations of bile acids (BA) in the diet were 60 mg/kg and 600 mg/kg, respectively.

quote: Serum ALT progressively decreased to the lowest activity with the increasing dietary BA
statement: 随着日粮中BA水平的增加，血清ALT活性逐渐降低至最低水平。
text_zh: 随着日粮中BA水平的增加，血清ALT活性逐渐降低至最低水平。
text_en: As the BA level in the diet increased, serum ALT activity gradually decreased to its lowest level.

quote: Before the feeding experiment, gibel carp were temporarily reared in indoor flow-through tanks (240 L/tank) to adapt to the laboratory environment for 2 weeks.
statement: 在投喂实验前，银鲫被暂时饲养在室内流水缸中两周以适应实验室环境。
text_zh: 在投喂实验前，银鲫被暂时饲养在室内流水缸中两周以适应实验室环境。
text_en: Before the feeding experiment, silver crucian carp were temporarily kept in indoor flow-through tanks for two weeks to acclimate to the laboratory environment.

population.species: Carassius auratus gibelio var. CAS III

quote: During acclimatization, fish were fed on the control diet (BA0) 4 times a day (8:00, 11:00, 14:00, and 17:00) to apparent satiation.
statement: 在驯化期间，鱼每天四次（8:00、11:00、14:00和17:00）投喂对照饲料至表观饱食。
text_zh: 在驯化期间，鱼每天四次（8:00、11:00、14:00和17:00）投喂对照饲料至表观饱食。
text_en: During acclimation, fish were fed the control diet to apparent satiation four times daily (8:00, 11:00, 14:00, and 17:00).

population.species: Carassius auratus gibelio var. CAS III

quote: Feed residues and feces were removed by siphoning after 45–60 min of feeding.
statement: 投喂后45-60分钟通过虹吸去除残饵和粪便。
text_zh: 投喂后45-60分钟通过虹吸去除残饵和粪便。
text_en: Remove leftover feed and feces by siphoning 45-60 minutes after feeding.

population.species: Carassius auratus gibelio var. CAS III

quote: Water quality was monitored regularly and maintained within the following range: water temperature 20–25 °C, dissolved oxygen greater than 5.5 mg/L, pH value 7–8, ammonia nitrogen less than 0.12 mg/L, and photoperiod 12 h light–12 h dark cycle.
statement: 定期监测水质并维持在以下范围：水温20-25°C，溶解氧大于5.5 mg/L，pH值7-8，氨氮小于0.12 mg/L，光周期12小时光照-12小时黑暗。
text_zh: 定期监测水质并维持在以下范围：水温20-25°C，溶解氧大于5.5 mg/L，pH值7-8，氨氮小于0.12 mg/L，光周期12小时光照-12小时黑暗。
text_en: Regularly monitor water quality and maintain it within the following ranges: water temperature 20-25°C, dissolved oxygen greater than 5.5 mg/L, pH 7-8, ammonia nitrogen less than 0.12 mg/L, and a photoperiod of 12 hours light-12 hours dark.

population.species: Carassius auratus gibelio var. CAS III

quote: After the 14-day acclimation, 450 healthy and uniform-sized gibel carp (initial body weight: 32.37 ± 0.13 g, age: 2 months) were randomly allocated to 5 groups with three 240 L replicate tanks (30 individuals/replicate tank).
statement: 经过14天的驯化后，将450条健康且大小均匀的银鲫随机分配到5组，每组三个240升的重复缸（每缸30尾）。
text_zh: 经过14天的驯化后，将450条健康且大小均匀的银鲫随机分配到5组，每组三个240升的重复缸（每缸30尾）。
text_en: After 14 days of acclimation, 450 healthy and uniformly sized gibel carp were randomly assigned to 5 groups, with three 240-liter replicate tanks per group (30 fish per tank).

population.species: Carassius auratus gibelio var. CAS III

quote: Previous studies have shown that exposure to Cd caused different toxic effects in gibel carp (Carassius gibelio) A strain (CAS III) and F strain (CAS V), regardless of whether via the dietborne or waterborne routes
statement: 先前的研究表明，无论通过饮食还是水体途径，镉暴露均导致银鲫A品系和F品系产生不同的毒性效应。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，无论通过饮食还是水体途径，镉暴露均导致银鲫A品系和F品系产生不同的毒性效应。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that cadmium exposure, whether through dietary or waterborne pathways, resulted in different toxic effects in Carassius gibelio A and F strains.

quote: To ascertain the potential of taurine in the prevention of Cd poisoning and to explore whether these effects would vary between the two strains, experiments were performed with taurine supplementation via the diet route in the present study.
statement: 为了确定牛磺酸预防镉中毒的潜力并探索这些效应在两个品系之间是否存在差异，本研究进行了通过饮食途径补充牛磺酸的实验。
text_zh: 为了确定牛磺酸预防镉中毒的潜力并探索这些效应在两个品系之间是否存在差异，本研究进行了通过饮食途径补充牛磺酸的实验。
text_en: To determine the potential of taurine to prevent cadmium toxicity and explore whether these effects differ between two strains, this study conducted an experiment supplementing taurine via the diet.

quote: The BA200 group showed a significantly lower degree of hyperemia and inflammation in the hepatopancreas
statement: 与对照组相比，添加200 mg/kg胆汁酸的组别在肝胰腺中表现出显著较低程度的充血和炎症。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，添加200 mg/kg胆汁酸的组别在肝胰腺中表现出显著较低程度的充血和炎症。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the group supplemented with 200 mg/kg bile acids showed significantly lower degrees of congestion and inflammation in the hepatopancreas.
outcome: 肝胰腺组织病理学（充血和炎症）

quote: The congestion and inflammatory phenomena further decreased in hepatopancreas with the increase in the dietary BA content to 400–600 mg/kg
statement: 随着日粮中胆汁酸含量增加到400-600 mg/kg，肝胰腺中的充血和炎症现象进一步减少。
text_zh: 随着日粮中胆汁酸含量增加到400-600 mg/kg，肝胰腺中的充血和炎症现象进一步减少。
text_en: As the bile acid content in the diet increased to 400-600 mg/kg, congestion and inflammation in the hepatopancreas further decreased.
outcome: 肝胰腺组织病理学（充血和炎症）

quote: However, more vacuolation and fewer nuclei were observed in the hepatopancreas of the BA400 group (Figure 2).
statement: 在BA400组中，肝胰腺观察到更多的空泡化和更少的细胞核。
text_zh: 在BA400组中，肝胰腺观察到更多的空泡化和更少的细胞核。
text_en: In the BA400 group, more vacuolization and fewer nuclei were observed in the hepatopancreas.
outcome: 肝胰腺组织病理学变化

quote: Nucleus migration and a small amount of congestion were observed in the central vein of the BA800 group, accompanied by smaller hepatocytes and evident vacuolar degeneration (Figure 2).
statement: 在BA800组中，中央静脉观察到核迁移和少量充血，伴随肝细胞变小和明显的空泡变性。
text_zh: 在BA800组中，中央静脉观察到核迁移和少量充血，伴随肝细胞变小和明显的空泡变性。
text_en: In the BA800 group, nuclear migration and slight congestion were observed in the central vein, accompanied by hepatocyte shrinkage and obvious vacuolar degeneration.
outcome: 肝胰腺组织病理学变化

quote: Cd exposure was reported to induce apoptosis in topsmelt, purse red common carp, and gibel carp [ 25 , 51 , 52 ].
statement: 据报道，镉暴露会诱导银汉鱼、红鲤和异育银鲫发生凋亡。
text_zh: 据报道，镉暴露会诱导银汉鱼、红鲤和异育银鲫发生凋亡。
text_en: It is reported that cadmium exposure induces apoptosis in silverfish, red carp, and allogynogenetic gibel carp.

population.species: topsmelt, purse red common carp, and gibel carp

quote: In the present study, the transcriptional levels of casp9 and casp3 were inhibited in the A strain fed the diet supplemented with taurine.
statement: 在本研究中，饲喂补充牛磺酸饲料的A品系中casp9和casp3的转录水平受到抑制。
text_zh: 在本研究中，饲喂补充牛磺酸饲料的A品系中casp9和casp3的转录水平受到抑制。
text_en: In this study, the transcription levels of casp9 and casp3 in strain A fed a diet supplemented with taurine were inhibited.

quote: Meanwhile, the apoptotic index in the A strain after Cd exposure was higher than in other groups as shown by the TUNEL results, suggesting that Cd exposure caused higher levels of apoptosis, and dietary taurine supplementation manifested its antioxidant effects through the regulation of the caspase gene in the A strain.
statement: 同时，TUNEL结果显示，镉暴露后A品系的凋亡指数高于其他组，表明镉暴露导致更高水平的凋亡，且膳食牛磺酸补充通过调节A品系中的半胱天冬酶基因表现出其抗氧化作用。
text_zh: 同时，TUNEL结果显示，镉暴露后A品系的凋亡指数高于其他组，表明镉暴露导致更高水平的凋亡，且膳食牛磺酸补充通过调节A品系中的半胱天冬酶基因表现出其抗氧化作用。
text_en: Meanwhile, TUNEL results showed that the apoptosis index in strain A was higher than in other groups after cadmium exposure, indicating that cadmium exposure led to a higher level of apoptosis, and dietary taurine supplementation exhibited its antioxidant effect by regulating caspase genes in strain A.

quote: In the present study, no significant variation in bcl2 expression was found after exposure to Cd, while the expression of ero1α was significantly elevated, indicating that apoptosis was induced by Cd exposure.
statement: 在本研究中，镉暴露后bcl2表达无显著变化，而ero1α表达显著升高，表明镉暴露诱导了凋亡。
text_zh: 在本研究中，镉暴露后bcl2表达无显著变化，而ero1α表达显著升高，表明镉暴露诱导了凋亡。
text_en: In this study, bcl2 expression showed no significant change after cadmium exposure, while ero1α expression increased significantly, indicating that cadmium exposure induced apoptosis.

quote: Thus, the increased availability of exogenous BA can enhance cholesterol clearance, transport, and lipid digestion within the liver [ 16 ], thereby lowering intrahepatic fat accumulation in the HFD-fed gibel carp.
statement: 外源性胆汁酸可用性的增加可以增强肝脏内的胆固醇清除、转运和脂质消化，从而降低高脂饮食鲤鱼的肝内脂肪积累。
text_zh: 外源性胆汁酸可用性的增加可以增强肝脏内的胆固醇清除、转运和脂质消化，从而降低高脂饮食鲤鱼的肝内脂肪积累。
text_en: Increased availability of exogenous bile acids can enhance hepatic cholesterol clearance, transport, and lipid digestion, thereby reducing intrahepatic fat accumulation in carp fed a high-fat diet.

quote: However, this favorable effect is likely reversed in the presence of excessive doses of dietary BA (higher than 600 mg/kg).
statement: 然而，当存在过量膳食胆汁酸（高于600 mg/kg）时，这种有利效果可能会发生逆转。
text_zh: 然而，当存在过量膳食胆汁酸（高于600 mg/kg）时，这种有利效果可能会发生逆转。
text_en: However, when there is an excess of dietary bile acids (above 600 mg/kg), this beneficial effect may be reversed.

quote: BAs have been verified as effective feed additives with benefits in growth, nutrient metabolism, and immune function in multiple aquatic animals, especially those fed high-energy diets [ 10 , 12 , 13 , 14 ].
statement: 胆汁酸已被证实为有效的饲料添加剂，在多种水生动物（特别是饲喂高能日粮者）中具有促进生长、改善营养代谢和免疫功能的好处。
text_zh: 胆汁酸已被证实为有效的饲料添加剂，在多种水生动物（特别是饲喂高能日粮者）中具有促进生长、改善营养代谢和免疫功能的好处。
text_en: Bile acids have been proven to be effective feed additives, with benefits in promoting growth, improving nutritional metabolism and immune function in various aquatic animals (especially those fed high-energy diets).

quote: For example, the supplementation of dietary BA at 60–600 mg/kg showed a positive effect on common carp (Cyprinus carpio L.) [ 17 ], whereas the promoting effect of BA was found in largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) fed 900 mg/kg BA supplemented in HFDs [ 10 ].
statement: 例如，日粮中添加60-600毫克/千克的胆汁酸对鲤鱼有正面影响，而在饲喂含900毫克/千克胆汁酸的高脂日粮的大口黑鲈中发现了促进作用。
text_zh: 例如，日粮中添加60-600毫克/千克的胆汁酸对鲤鱼有正面影响，而在饲喂含900毫克/千克胆汁酸的高脂日粮的大口黑鲈中发现了促进作用。
text_en: For example, dietary supplementation with 60-600 mg/kg bile acids had a positive effect on common carp, while a promoting effect was found in largemouth bass fed high-fat diets containing 900 mg/kg bile acids.

quote: Overall, dietary BA with an optimal concentration (400–600 mg/kg) can both diminish fat and the relevant metabolite synthesis and accelerate lipolysis and fatty acid transport in the hepatopancreas of gibel carp, thereby minimizing HFD-triggered harmful effects in fish.
statement: 日粮中添加最佳浓度（400–600 mg/kg）的BA可以减少脂肪及相关代谢物合成，加速肝胰腺中的脂解和脂肪酸转运，从而减轻高脂饮食对鱼类的有害影响。
text_zh: 日粮中添加最佳浓度（400–600 mg/kg）的BA可以减少脂肪及相关代谢物合成，加速肝胰腺中的脂解和脂肪酸转运，从而减轻高脂饮食对鱼类的有害影响。
text_en: Adding the optimal concentration (400–600 mg/kg) of BA to the diet can reduce the synthesis of fat and related metabolites, accelerate lipolysis and fatty acid transport in the hepatopancreas, thereby alleviating the harmful effects of a high-fat diet on fish.

quote: Additionally, the potential risk caused by excessive BAs in gibel carp, such as the rebound in some BA synthesis genes (cyp27a1) in the BA800 group, and its molecular mechanism are still unclear and need further investigation.
statement: 过量胆汁酸对鲫鱼造成的潜在风险（如BA800组中某些胆汁酸合成基因的反跳）及其分子机制尚不清楚，需要进一步研究。
text_zh: 过量胆汁酸对鲫鱼造成的潜在风险（如BA800组中某些胆汁酸合成基因的反跳）及其分子机制尚不清楚，需要进一步研究。
text_en: The potential risks caused by excessive bile acids to crucian carp (such as the rebound of certain bile acid synthesis genes in the BA800 group) and their molecular mechanisms are not yet clear, requiring further research.
counterevidence: BA800组中出现胆汁酸合成基因反跳

quote: relatively higher HDL and lower LDL levels in the serum of fish from the BA400 and BA600 groups indicated a significantly reduced cholesterol flux from the liver to the blood and extrahepatic tissues and a higher hepatic uptake/metabolism of dietary lipids, which could mitigate the possible metabolic risk in HFD-fed cyprinid fish [ 4 ].
statement: BA400和BA600组鱼类血清中相对较高的HDL和较低的LDL水平表明胆固醇从肝脏向血液和肝外组织的通量显著减少，以及膳食脂质的肝脏摄取/代谢增加，这可能减轻高脂饮食鲤科鱼类的潜在代谢风险。
text_zh: BA400和BA600组鱼类血清中相对较高的HDL和较低的LDL水平表明胆固醇从肝脏向血液和肝外组织的通量显著减少，以及膳食脂质的肝脏摄取/代谢增加，这可能减轻高脂饮食鲤科鱼类的潜在代谢风险。
text_en: The relatively high HDL and low LDL levels in the serum of fish in the BA400 and BA600 groups indicate a significant reduction in cholesterol flux from the liver to the blood and extrahepatic tissues, as well as increased hepatic uptake/metabolism of dietary lipids, which may mitigate potential metabolic risks in cyprinid fish fed high-fat diets.

quote: Nevertheless, excessive doses of BA and its metabolites can unfavorably affect the physiological and metabolic responses involved in fish growth and health via the disruption of BA homeostasis within the enterohepatic circulation
statement: 然而，过量的胆汁酸及其代谢物可通过破坏肠肝循环中的胆汁酸稳态，对涉及鱼类生长和健康的生理和代谢反应产生不利影响。
text_zh: 然而，过量的胆汁酸及其代谢物可通过破坏肠肝循环中的胆汁酸稳态，对涉及鱼类生长和健康的生理和代谢反应产生不利影响。
text_en: However, excessive bile acids and their metabolites can adversely affect physiological and metabolic responses involved in fish growth and health by disrupting bile acid homeostasis in the enterohepatic circulation.

quote: Elevated TC contents related to superabundant BA-induced hepatotoxicity were not significantly observed in this study, which could mainly be attributed to a broad range of BA tolerance in gibel carp
statement: 本研究中未观察到与过量胆汁酸诱导的肝毒性相关的TC含量升高，这主要可归因于银鲫对胆汁酸具有较宽的耐受范围。
text_zh: 本研究中未观察到与过量胆汁酸诱导的肝毒性相关的TC含量升高，这主要可归因于银鲫对胆汁酸具有较宽的耐受范围。
text_en: In this study, no increase in TC content associated with hepatotoxicity induced by excessive bile acids was observed, which is mainly attributable to the wide tolerance range of gibel carp for bile acids.

quote: hepatic structure damages, including swollen cells, hazy cell margins, fat vacuolization, and inflammatory infiltration, could be relieved in gibel carp, especially those supplied with 400–600 mg/kg BA.
statement: 在银鲫中，包括细胞肿胀、细胞边界模糊、脂肪空泡化和炎性浸润在内的肝脏结构损伤可以得到缓解，尤其是那些补充了400–600 mg/kg胆汁酸的个体。

text_en: In silver crucian carp, liver structural damage including cell swelling, blurred cell boundaries, fat vacuolization and inflammatory infiltration can be alleviated, especially in individuals supplemented with 400–600 mg/kg bile acids.

quote: But the liver exhibited cellular infiltration and more nuclear migration following higher levels of BA (800 mg/kg).

text_en: However, after higher levels of bile acids (800 mg/kg), the liver showed cellular infiltration and more nuclear migration.

quote: Significant increases in serum AST and ALT were also observed in striped catfish (Pangasianodon hypophthalmus) supplemented with 1500 mg/kg BA [ 29 ].
statement: 在补充1500 mg/kg BA的条纹鲶鱼中，也观察到血清AST和ALT显著增加。
text_zh: 在补充1500 mg/kg BA的条纹鲶鱼中，也观察到血清AST和ALT显著增加。

text_zh: 因此，膳食BA对高能日粮引起的鱼类肝损伤的缓解作用与其浓度和鱼类品种密切相关。

text_en: Overall, the results indicate that cadmium exposure induced autophagy, and a stronger autophagic response was observed in the F strain fed taurine-supplemented feed.
