outcome: 疾病抗性与抗生素替代

quote: This study aimed to investigate the regulatory effects of dietary carvacrol on intestinal micro biota composition, serum metabolic profiles, and their association with increased resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila in Pengze crucian carp.
statement: 本研究旨在探讨日粮香芹酚对彭泽鲫肠道微生物群组成、血清代谢谱及其与嗜水气单胞菌抗性增强之间关联的调节作用。
text_zh: 本研究旨在探讨日粮香芹酚对彭泽鲫肠道微生物群组成、血清代谢谱及其与嗜水气单胞菌抗性增强之间关联的调节作用。
text_en: This study aims to investigate the regulatory effects of dietary carvacrol on the composition of the gut microbiota, serum metabolic profile, and their association with enhanced resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila in Pengze crucian carp.

quote: The addition of carvacrol to the feed significantly altered the intestinal microbial structure.
statement: 饲料中添加香芹酚显著改变了肠道微生物结构。
text_zh: 饲料中添加香芹酚显著改变了肠道微生物结构。
text_en: The addition of carvacrol to feed significantly altered the gut microbial structure.

quote: After challenge with A. hydrophila , the intestinal microbial community structure was disrupted, and the degree of disruption was higher between the CK groups compared to the CA groups.
statement: 在嗜水气单胞菌攻毒后，肠道微生物群落结构受到破坏，且对照组（CK）的破坏程度高于香芹酚组（CA）。
text_zh: 在嗜水气单胞菌攻毒后，肠道微生物群落结构受到破坏，且对照组（CK）的破坏程度高于香芹酚组（CA）。
text_en: After challenge with Aeromonas hydrophila, the gut microbial community structure was disrupted, and the degree of disruption in the control group (CK) was higher than that in the carvacrol group (CA).
outcome: 肠道微生物稳定性/抗病力

quote: There was no significant difference observed between CA12 and CA0 (p > 0.05), whereas a significant difference was noted between CK12 and CK0
statement: 香芹酚组攻毒前后（CA12与CA0）无显著差异，而对照组攻毒前后（CK12与CK0）存在显著差异。
text_zh: 香芹酚组攻毒前后（CA12与CA0）无显著差异，而对照组攻毒前后（CK12与CK0）存在显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in the carvacrol group before and after challenge (CA12 vs CA0), whereas there was a significant difference in the control group before and after challenge (CK12 vs CK0).
outcome: 肠道微生物多样性稳定性

quote: BA supplementation at 400–600 mg/kg could effectively reverse multiple serum biochemical parameters linked with liver metabolism and damage in gibel carp under HFD conditions, along with the alleviation of liver histological anomalies.
statement: 在高脂饮食条件下，400-600 mg/kg的BA补充能有效逆转与银鲫肝脏代谢和损伤相关的多种血清生化参数，并缓解肝脏组织学异常。
text_zh: 在高脂饮食条件下，400-600 mg/kg的BA补充能有效逆转与银鲫肝脏代谢和损伤相关的多种血清生化参数，并缓解肝脏组织学异常。
text_en: Under high-fat diet conditions, supplementation with 400-600 mg/kg BA effectively reverses multiple serum biochemical parameters associated with liver metabolism and damage in gibel carp, and alleviates histological abnormalities in the liver.

quote: Additionally, carvacrol has been reported to exhibit potent anti-inflammatory effects by inhibiting the activity of COX and LOX enzymes [ 43 , 44 ], reducing the production of arachidonic acid metabolites and decreasing inflammatory responses [ 45 ].
statement: 据报道，香芹酚通过抑制COX和LOX酶的活性表现出强效抗炎作用，减少花生四烯酸代谢物的产生并降低炎症反应。
text_zh: 据报道，香芹酚通过抑制COX和LOX酶的活性表现出强效抗炎作用，减少花生四烯酸代谢物的产生并降低炎症反应。
text_en: It is reported that carvacrol exhibits strong anti-inflammatory effects by inhibiting the activity of COX and LOX enzymes, reducing the production of arachidonic acid metabolites and lowering inflammatory responses.

quote: However, 12 h post-challenge, the organismal systems in the CA group were significantly lower than those in the CK group (p
statement: 攻毒后12小时，CA组的有机体系统显著低于CK组。
text_zh: 攻毒后12小时，CA组的有机体系统显著低于CK组。
text_en: At 12 hours post-challenge, the organism system of the CA group was significantly lower than that of the CK group.
intervention_record: 香芹酚添加与病原攻毒
outcome: 肠道微生物功能（有机体系统）

quote: The addition of carvacrol resulted in a separation trend in serum metabolites.
statement: 添加香芹酚导致血清代谢物出现分离趋势。
text_zh: 添加香芹酚导致血清代谢物出现分离趋势。
text_en: Adding carvacrol led to a separation trend in serum metabolites.

quote: Challenge with pathogens significantly altered the composition of serum metabolites, with a notable separation observed post-challenge in the CK group compared to the CA group.
statement: 病原攻毒显著改变了血清代谢物的组成，且攻毒后CK组与CA组之间观察到明显的分离。
text_zh: 病原攻毒显著改变了血清代谢物的组成，且攻毒后CK组与CA组之间观察到明显的分离。
text_en: Pathogen challenge significantly altered the composition of serum metabolites, and clear separation was observed between the CK group and the CA group after the challenge.

quote: Post-challenge analysis demonstrated marked declines in intestinal microbial diversity indices (Observed ASV, Chao1, ACE, and PD whole tree) in the CK group, whereas the CA group maintained stable microbial diversity.
statement: 攻毒后分析显示，CK组的肠道微生物多样性指数（观察到的ASV、Chao1、ACE和PD全树）显著下降，而CA组保持了稳定的微生物多样性。
text_zh: 攻毒后分析显示，CK组的肠道微生物多样性指数（观察到的ASV、Chao1、ACE和PD全树）显著下降，而CA组保持了稳定的微生物多样性。
text_en: Post-challenge analysis showed that the intestinal microbial diversity indices (observed ASVs, Chao1, ACE, and PD whole tree) significantly decreased in the CK group, while the CA group maintained stable microbial diversity.

quote: Pathogenic genera including Aeromonas , Shewanella , and Vibrio showed significant proliferation in challenged controls, contrasting with maintained microbial homeostasis in carvacrol-fed specimens.
statement: 包括气单胞菌属、希瓦氏菌属和弧菌属在内的致病菌属在受攻击的对照组中显示出显著增殖，这与喂食香芹酚的样本中维持的微生物稳态形成对比。
text_zh: 包括气单胞菌属、希瓦氏菌属和弧菌属在内的致病菌属在受攻击的对照组中显示出显著增殖，这与喂食香芹酚的样本中维持的微生物稳态形成对比。
text_en: Pathogenic genera including Aeromonas, Shewanella, and Vibrio showed significant proliferation in the challenged control group, contrasting with the microbial homeostasis maintained in samples fed carvacrol.
outcome: 病原菌控制/微生物稳态

quote: Our results demonstrate that dietary carvacrol may reinforce intestinal microbial barrier function by optimizing beneficial microbial composition and reducing the proportion of pathogens, and modulate immune-related metabolic pathways critical for host defense, which might be involved in enhanced disease resistance.
statement: 我们的结果表明，日粮中的香芹酚可能通过优化有益微生物组成和减少病原体比例来加强肠道微生物屏障功能，并调节对宿主防御至关重要的免疫相关代谢途径，这可能涉及增强疾病抵抗力。
text_zh: 我们的结果表明，日粮中的香芹酚可能通过优化有益微生物组成和减少病原体比例来加强肠道微生物屏障功能，并调节对宿主防御至关重要的免疫相关代谢途径，这可能涉及增强疾病抵抗力。
text_en: Our results indicate that dietary carvacrol may strengthen intestinal microbial barrier function by optimizing the composition of beneficial microorganisms and reducing the proportion of pathogens, and regulate immune-related metabolic pathways critical for host defense, which may involve enhanced disease resistance.
outcome: 疾病抵抗力/肠道屏障功能

quote: Compared to the CK0 samples, 76 serum metabolites were significantly upregulated (p p p p A. hydrophila in the CK group (CK12 vs. CK0).
statement: 与CK0样本相比，CK组中嗜水气单胞菌感染导致76种血清代谢物显著上调。
text_zh: 与CK0样本相比，CK组中嗜水气单胞菌感染导致76种血清代谢物显著上调。
text_en: Compared to CK0 samples, Aeromonas hydrophila infection resulted in the significant upregulation of 76 serum metabolites in the CK group.

quote: In contrast, in the carvacrol-treated group post-challenge, 419 significantly increased metabolites (p p A. hydrophila in the CA group (CA12 vs. CA0).
statement: 相比之下，在香芹酚处理组攻击后，CA组中嗜水气单胞菌感染导致419种代谢物显著增加。
text_zh: 相比之下，在香芹酚处理组攻击后，CA组中嗜水气单胞菌感染导致419种代谢物显著增加。
text_en: In contrast, after challenge in the carvacrol-treated group, Aeromonas hydrophila infection led to a significant increase in 419 metabolites in the CA group.

quote: When comparing the metabolites between CA and CK group at 12 h post-challenge, 342 serum metabolites were significantly upregulated (p p A VIP plot was generated by selecting the top 20 metabolites with the highest VIP scores from each group in the OPLS-DA model.
statement: 比较攻击后12小时CA组和CK组的代谢物时，342种血清代谢物显著上调。
text_zh: 比较攻击后12小时CA组和CK组的代谢物时，342种血清代谢物显著上调。
text_en: When comparing serum metabolites between the CA group and the CK group at 12 hours post-attack, 342 serum metabolites were significantly upregulated.

quote: A study by Qi et al. on zebrafish revealed that vitamin B12 produced by intestinal Cetobacterium is vital for zebrafish to resist A. hydrophila infection and significantly improves the stability of the intestinal microbial ecological network
statement: Qi等人的研究表明，斑马鱼肠道中Cetobacterium产生的维生素B12对于抵抗嗜水气单胞菌感染至关重要，并显著改善了肠道微生物生态网络的稳定性。
text_zh: Qi等人的研究表明，斑马鱼肠道中Cetobacterium产生的维生素B12对于抵抗嗜水气单胞菌感染至关重要，并显著改善了肠道微生物生态网络的稳定性。
text_en: Qi et al. showed that vitamin B12 produced by Cetobacterium in the zebrafish gut is essential for resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila infection and significantly improved the stability of the gut microbial ecological network.
outcome: 抗病能力与肠道菌群稳定性

quote: the statistical analysis of α-diversity of intestinal microbiota in Pengze crucian carp showed no significant effect from the addition of carvacrol in this experiment
statement: 对彭泽鲫肠道微生物群α多样性的统计分析显示，本实验中添加香芹酚没有产生显著影响。
text_zh: 对彭泽鲫肠道微生物群α多样性的统计分析显示，本实验中添加香芹酚没有产生显著影响。
text_en: Statistical analysis of the intestinal microbiota α-diversity of Pengze crucian carp showed that the addition of carvacrol in this experiment did not produce a significant effect.

quote: comparisons before and after pathogen challenge revealed that the stability of intestinal microbiota diversity was superior in the CA group compared to CK
statement: 病原攻毒前后的比较显示，CA组（香芹酚组）的肠道微生物多样性稳定性优于CK组（对照组）。
text_zh: 病原攻毒前后的比较显示，CA组（香芹酚组）的肠道微生物多样性稳定性优于CK组（对照组）。
text_en: Comparisons before and after pathogen challenge showed that the stability of gut microbial diversity in the CA group (carvacrol group) was better than that in the CK group (control group).
outcome: 肠道微生物多样性稳定性

quote: after the pathogen challenge, the relative abundance of A. hydrophila in the intestine decreased by 39.19% in the CA group, indicating that carvacrol enhanced the environmental resistance of the intestinal microbiota in Pengze crucian carp, improved its intestinal microbial barrier function, and decreased the abundance of A. hydrophila
statement: 病原攻毒后，CA组肠道中嗜水气单胞菌的相对丰度降低了39.19%，表明香芹酚增强了彭泽鲫肠道微生物群的环境抵抗力，改善了其肠道微生物屏障功能，并降低了嗜水气单胞菌的丰度。
text_zh: 病原攻毒后，CA组肠道中嗜水气单胞菌的相对丰度降低了39.19%，表明香芹酚增强了彭泽鲫肠道微生物群的环境抵抗力，改善了其肠道微生物屏障功能，并降低了嗜水气单胞菌的丰度。
text_en: After pathogen challenge, the relative abundance of Aeromonas hydrophila in the intestines of the CA group decreased by 39.19%, indicating that carvacrol enhanced the environmental resistance of the gut microbiota of Pengze crucian carp, improved its intestinal microbial barrier function, and reduced the abundance of Aeromonas hydrophila.
outcome: 肠道致病菌丰度与屏障功能

quote: Dang et al. found that feeding rainbow trout with oregano essential oil increased the levels of beneficial intestinal bacteria such as Streptococcus lutetiensis , Oscillospirales , and Methylobacterium-Methylorubrum , while reducing the levels of potentially harmful intestinal bacteria such as Mycoplasma , Mor
statement: Dang等人发现，给虹鳟喂食牛至精油增加了Streptococcus lutetiensis、Oscillospirales和Methylobacterium-Methylorubrum等有益肠道细菌的水平，同时减少了Mycoplasma等潜在有害肠道细菌的水平。
text_zh: Dang等人发现，给虹鳟喂食牛至精油增加了Streptococcus lutetiensis、Oscillospirales和Methylobacterium-Methylorubrum等有益肠道细菌的水平，同时减少了Mycoplasma等潜在有害肠道细菌的水平。
text_en: Dang et al. found that feeding rainbow trout oregano essential oil increased the levels of beneficial gut bacteria such as Streptococcus lutetiensis, Oscillospirales, and Methylobacterium-Methylorubrum, while reducing the levels of potentially harmful gut bacteria such as Mycoplasma.

quote: Both the acclimation and feeding phases were performed in aquariums (60.0 cm × 60.0 cm × 80.0 cm) with a recirculating filtration system.
statement: 驯化和饲养阶段均在带有循环过滤系统的水族箱中进行。
text_zh: 驯化和饲养阶段均在带有循环过滤系统的水族箱中进行。
text_en: Both the acclimation and rearing stages were conducted in aquariums equipped with a recirculating filtration system.

quote: The feeding trial lasted for 8 weeks, during which the fish were manually fed to apparent satiation twice daily (at 09:00 and 15:00).
statement: 饲养试验持续8周，期间每天两次（09:00和15:00）人工投喂至表观饱食。
text_zh: 饲养试验持续8周，期间每天两次（09:00和15:00）人工投喂至表观饱食。
text_en: The feeding trial lasted for 8 weeks, during which artificial feeding to apparent satiation was carried out twice daily (at 09:00 and 15:00).

quote: The initial feeding rate was set at 3% of the fish’s body weight and adjusted accordingly based on their feeding behavior.
statement: 初始投喂率设定为鱼体重的3%，并根据其摄食行为进行相应调整。
text_zh: 初始投喂率设定为鱼体重的3%，并根据其摄食行为进行相应调整。
text_en: The initial feeding rate was set at 3% of body weight and adjusted accordingly based on feeding behavior.
intervention_record: 按摄食行为调整投喂率

quote: Throughout the experiment, one-third of the water in each aquarium was replaced daily with isothermal aerated water, and continuous aeration was provided using an air pump.
statement: 在整个实验过程中，每天更换每个水族箱三分之一的水，使用等温曝气水，并使用气泵提供连续曝气。
text_zh: 在整个实验过程中，每天更换每个水族箱三分之一的水，使用等温曝气水，并使用气泵提供连续曝气。
text_en: Throughout the entire experiment, one-third of the water in each aquarium was replaced daily using isothermal aerated water, and continuous aeration was provided by an air pump.
intervention: Daily water change with continuous aeration

quote: Daily water quality monitoring was performed to ensure that the following conditions were maintained: pH (6.5–7.6), dissolved oxygen (>6.80 mg/L), temperature (27.8 ± 0.9 °C), and nitrate
statement: 每天进行水质监测以确保维持以下条件：pH值（6.5–7.6）、溶解氧（>6.80 mg/L）、温度（27.8 ± 0.9 °C）和硝酸盐
text_zh: 每天进行水质监测以确保维持以下条件：pH值（6.5–7.6）、溶解氧（>6.80 mg/L）、温度（27.8 ± 0.9 °C）和硝酸盐
text_en: Water quality is monitored daily to ensure the following conditions are maintained: pH (6.5–7.6), dissolved oxygen (>6.80 mg/L), temperature (27.8 ± 0.9 °C) and nitrates

quote: Combined with our previous observations, dietary supplementation of 600 mg/kg carvacrol improved intestinal morphological integrity and reduced the levels of the intestinal pro-inflammatory cytokines tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) and interleukin-1β (IL-1β) [ 19 ].
statement: 结合我们之前的观察结果，日粮中添加600 mg/kg的香芹酚改善了肠道形态完整性，并降低了肠道促炎细胞因子肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）和白介素-1β（IL-1β）的水平。
text_zh: 结合我们之前的观察结果，日粮中添加600 mg/kg的香芹酚改善了肠道形态完整性，并降低了肠道促炎细胞因子肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）和白介素-1β（IL-1β）的水平。
text_en: Combining our previous observations, dietary supplementation with 600 mg/kg carvacrol improved intestinal morphological integrity and reduced the levels of the pro-inflammatory cytokines tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) and interleukin-1β (IL-1β).

quote: The following hepatopancreas function indices in the serum were measured using an ADVIA2400 Automatic Biochemistry Analyzer (Siemens, Munich, Germany) and commercial kits (Beijing Solarbio Science and Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing, China) according to the manufacturer’s instructions: alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), alkaline phosphatase (ALP), adenosine deaminase (ADA), total bilirubin (T-Bil), total protein (TP), albumin (ALB), and globulin (GLB).
statement: 血清中的肝胰腺功能指标（包括ALT、AST、ALP、ADA、总胆红素、总蛋白、白蛋白和球蛋白）使用自动生化分析仪和商业试剂盒按照制造商说明进行测量。
text_zh: 血清中的肝胰腺功能指标（包括ALT、AST、ALP、ADA、总胆红素、总蛋白、白蛋白和球蛋白）使用自动生化分析仪和商业试剂盒按照制造商说明进行测量。
text_en: Hepatopancreatic function indicators in serum (including ALT, AST, ALP, ADA, total bilirubin, total protein, albumin and globulin) were measured using an automatic biochemical analyzer and commercial kits according to the manufacturer's instructions.

quote: The level of MDA in the hepatopancreas tissue was measured using an MDA kit (Beijing Solarbio Science and Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing, China).
statement: 肝胰腺组织中的丙二醛（MDA）水平使用MDA试剂盒进行测量。
text_zh: 肝胰腺组织中的丙二醛（MDA）水平使用MDA试剂盒进行测量。
text_en: Malondialdehyde (MDA) levels in hepatopancreas tissue were measured using an MDA kit.

quote: Enterococcus and Plesiomonas in the CA group significantly increased
statement: CA组中的肠球菌属和副气单胞菌属显著增加。
text_zh: CA组中的肠球菌属和副气单胞菌属显著增加。
text_en: Enterococcus and Aeromonas increased significantly in the CA group.

quote: Aeromonas , Shewanella and Vibrio were significantly increased in the CK group after being exposed to A. hydrophila
statement: 在暴露于嗜水气单胞菌后，CK组中的气单胞菌属、希瓦氏菌属和弧菌属显著增加。
text_zh: 在暴露于嗜水气单胞菌后，CK组中的气单胞菌属、希瓦氏菌属和弧菌属显著增加。
text_en: After exposure to Aeromonas hydrophila, the genera Aeromonas, Shewanella, and Vibrio significantly increased in the CK group.

quote: Studies have reported that carvacrol possesses strong antioxidant capabilities, potentially mitigating oxidative stress during linoleic acid metabolism by reducing the generation or scavenging of free radicals [ 47 ].
statement: 已有研究报道香芹酚具有强抗氧化能力，可能通过减少自由基的生成或清除来缓解亚油酸代谢过程中的氧化应激。
text_zh: 已有研究报道香芹酚具有强抗氧化能力，可能通过减少自由基的生成或清除来缓解亚油酸代谢过程中的氧化应激。
text_en: Existing studies have reported that carvacrol has strong antioxidant capacity, which may alleviate oxidative stress during linoleic acid metabolism by reducing the generation or scavenging of free radicals.

quote: They not only facilitate the absorption of lipids in the intestinal tract of aquatic animals [ 49 ] but also exert notable effects on intestinal microbiota and immune function.
statement: 它们不仅促进水生动物肠道中的脂质吸收，而且对肠道微生物群和免疫功能产生显著影响。
text_zh: 它们不仅促进水生动物肠道中的脂质吸收，而且对肠道微生物群和免疫功能产生显著影响。
text_en: They not only promote lipid absorption in the intestines of aquatic animals, but also have significant effects on gut microbiota and immune function.
outcome: 脂质吸收、肠道微生物群、免疫功能

quote: Previous studies have shown that exogenous bile acid supplementation can enhance intestinal microbial diversity [ 50 ] and reduce the abundance of harmful bacteria [ 51 ], primarily by promoting the secretion of antimicrobial peptides by intestinal epithelial cells [ 52 ] and maintaining intestinal barrier function [ 53 ].
statement: 先前的研究表明，外源性胆汁酸补充可以通过促进肠上皮细胞分泌抗菌肽和维持肠道屏障功能，增强肠道微生物多样性并减少有害细菌的丰度。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，外源性胆汁酸补充可以通过促进肠上皮细胞分泌抗菌肽和维持肠道屏障功能，增强肠道微生物多样性并减少有害细菌的丰度。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that exogenous bile acid supplementation can enhance intestinal microbial diversity and reduce the abundance of harmful bacteria by promoting the secretion of antimicrobial peptides by intestinal epithelial cells and maintaining intestinal barrier function.
outcome: 肠道微生物多样性、有害细菌丰度、肠道屏障功能

quote: After infection with pathogenic bacteria, serum metabolic differences in the control group were enriched in the autophagy signaling pathway, while those in the carvacrol-added group were enriched in the mTOR signaling pathway.
statement: 感染致病菌后，对照组的血清代谢差异富集于自噬信号通路，而添加香芹酚组的差异富集于mTOR信号通路。
text_zh: 感染致病菌后，对照组的血清代谢差异富集于自噬信号通路，而添加香芹酚组的差异富集于mTOR信号通路。
text_en: After infection with pathogenic bacteria, serum metabolic differences in the control group were enriched in the autophagy signaling pathway, while those in the carvacrol-supplemented group were enriched in the mTOR signaling pathway.

quote: However, under the stress of A. hydrophila , carvacrol inhibits the autophagy process, potentially through the mTOR signaling pathway.
statement: 然而，在嗜水气单胞菌胁迫下，香芹酚抑制自噬过程，可能通过mTOR信号通路实现。
text_zh: 然而，在嗜水气单胞菌胁迫下，香芹酚抑制自噬过程，可能通过mTOR信号通路实现。
text_en: However, under Aeromonas hydrophila stress, carvacrol inhibits the autophagy process, possibly through the mTOR signaling pathway.
limitations: 仅在嗜水气单胞菌胁迫条件下
counterevidence: 与单独添加时可能促进自噬的推测相反

quote: In conclusion, this study demonstrates that dietary carvacrol exerts dual protective effects in Pengze crucian carp through: (1) modulating intestinal microbial composition by suppressing Firmicutes proliferation while promoting beneficial Cetobacterium growth (33.25% increase), and enhancing microbial community stability and ecological resilience, which significantly reduces the proportion of A. hydrophila ;
statement: 膳食添加香芹酚通过调节肠道微生物组成，抑制厚壁菌门增殖并促进有益鲸杆菌属生长，增强微生物群落稳定性和生态恢复力，从而显著降低嗜水气单胞菌的比例。
text_zh: 膳食添加香芹酚通过调节肠道微生物组成，抑制厚壁菌门增殖并促进有益鲸杆菌属生长，增强微生物群落稳定性和生态恢复力，从而显著降低嗜水气单胞菌的比例。
text_en: Dietary carvacrol significantly reduced the proportion of Aeromonas hydrophila by modulating gut microbiota composition, inhibiting the proliferation of Firmicutes and promoting the growth of beneficial Cetobacterium, thereby enhancing microbial community stability and ecological resilience.
outcome: 肠道健康与病原菌控制

quote: In fish, Cd exposure causes histopathological changes in hepatopancreas tissue (Sövényi and Szakolczai, 1993 ; Selvanathan et al., 2013 ; Liu et al., 2018).
statement: 鱼类暴露于镉会导致肝胰腺组织发生病理变化。
text_zh: 鱼类暴露于镉会导致肝胰腺组织发生病理变化。
text_en: Exposure of fish to cadmium causes pathological changes in hepatopancreas tissue.

quote: Wang et al. (2019) reported that acute Cd exposure had negative effects on stress defense, immunity, and metal transport systems in the hepatopancreas of zebrafish (Danio rerio) and grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella).
statement: 急性镉暴露对斑马鱼和草鱼肝胰腺中的应激防御、免疫和金属转运系统有负面影响。
text_zh: 急性镉暴露对斑马鱼和草鱼肝胰腺中的应激防御、免疫和金属转运系统有负面影响。
text_en: Acute cadmium exposure has negative effects on the stress defense, immune, and metal transport systems in the hepatopancreas of zebrafish and grass carp.

quote: Previous reports also showed that under Cd stress, mortality and abnormality rates in 3n fish were lower than those of 2n strains, possibly due to their oxidative and endoplasmic reticulum stress responses.
statement: 在镉胁迫下，三倍体鱼的死亡率和畸形率低于二倍品系，这可能归因于其氧化和内质网应激反应。
text_zh: 在镉胁迫下，三倍体鱼的死亡率和畸形率低于二倍品系，这可能归因于其氧化和内质网应激反应。
text_en: Under cadmium stress, the mortality and malformation rates of triploid fish were lower than those of diploid strains, which may be attributed to their oxidative and endoplasmic reticulum stress responses.

quote: found that feeding rainbow trout with oregano essential oil increased the levels of beneficial intestinal bacteria such as Streptococcus lutetiensis , Oscillospirales , and Methylobacterium-Methylorubrum , while reducing the levels of potentially harmful intestinal bacteria such as Mycoplasma , Morganellaceae , and Paenalcaligenes .
statement: 饲喂牛至精油增加了虹鳟有益肠道细菌的水平，同时降低了潜在有害肠道细菌的水平。
text_zh: 饲喂牛至精油增加了虹鳟有益肠道细菌的水平，同时降低了潜在有害肠道细菌的水平。
text_en: Feeding oregano essential oil increased the levels of beneficial gut bacteria in rainbow trout, while decreasing the levels of potentially harmful gut bacteria.

quote: This treatment also enhanced the disease resistance of rainbow trout against Aeromonas salmonicida [ 28 ], aligning with the results of our experiment.
statement: 该处理增强了虹鳟对杀鲑气单胞菌的抗病力，这与本实验结果一致。
text_zh: 该处理增强了虹鳟对杀鲑气单胞菌的抗病力，这与本实验结果一致。
text_en: This treatment enhanced the resistance of rainbow trout to Aeromonas salmonicida, which is consistent with the results of this experiment.

quote: On one hand, carvacrol disrupts bacterial membrane permeability by altering unsaturated fatty acid composition and inhibiting ATP synthesis [ 29 ], thereby inhibiting and killing exogenous pathogens such as A. hydrophila and Edwardsiella tarda [ 12 , 30 ].
statement: 香芹酚通过改变不饱和脂肪酸组成和抑制ATP合成来破坏细菌膜通透性，从而抑制并杀死嗜水气单胞菌和爱德华氏菌等外源病原体。
text_zh: 香芹酚通过改变不饱和脂肪酸组成和抑制ATP合成来破坏细菌膜通透性，从而抑制并杀死嗜水气单胞菌和爱德华氏菌等外源病原体。
text_en: Carvacrol disrupts bacterial membrane permeability by altering unsaturated fatty acid composition and inhibiting ATP synthesis, thereby inhibiting and killing exogenous pathogens such as Aeromonas hydrophila and Edwardsiella.

quote: This provides ecological niches for intestinal commensal bacteria and promotes the enhancement of intestinal microbiota stability [ 31 ], and consequently strengthens the intestinal biological barrier function.
statement: 这为肠道共生菌提供了生态位，促进了肠道微生物群稳定性的增强，从而加强了肠道生物屏障功能。
text_zh: 这为肠道共生菌提供了生态位，促进了肠道微生物群稳定性的增强，从而加强了肠道生物屏障功能。
text_en: This provides an ecological niche for intestinal symbiotic bacteria, promotes the enhancement of gut microbiota stability, thereby strengthening the intestinal biological barrier function.

quote: On the other hand, our previous research showed that carvacrol promotes the structural integrity of fish intestines [ 19 ], effectively improving the physical and structural barriers within the intestines.
statement: 另一方面，我们之前的研究表明，香芹酚促进鱼类肠道的结构完整性，有效改善肠道内的物理和结构屏障。
text_zh: 另一方面，我们之前的研究表明，香芹酚促进鱼类肠道的结构完整性，有效改善肠道内的物理和结构屏障。
text_en: On the other hand, our previous studies have shown that carvacrol promotes the structural integrity of fish intestines and effectively improves the physical and structural barriers within the intestine.

quote: The role of carvacrol in enhancing the structural integrity of fish intestines may also be related to the increase in the content of Cetobacterium .
statement: 香芹酚在增强鱼类肠道结构完整性方面的作用也可能与鲸杆菌属含量的增加有关。
text_zh: 香芹酚在增强鱼类肠道结构完整性方面的作用也可能与鲸杆菌属含量的增加有关。
text_en: The effect of carvacrol on enhancing intestinal structural integrity in fish may also be related to an increase in the abundance of Cetobacterium.

quote: It has been reported that the cell-free culture supernatant (CFCS) of Cetobacterium isolated from the intestine of crucian carp (Carassius auratus) exhibits functions such as scavenging DPPH, hydroxyl radicals, and superoxide anions, and enhances the resistance of zebrafish to A. hydrophila infection [ 32 ].
statement: 据报道，从鲫鱼肠道中分离出的鲸杆菌属无细胞培养上清液具有清除DPPH、羟基自由基和超氧阴离子等功能，并增强斑马鱼对嗜水气单胞菌感染的抵抗力。
text_zh: 据报道，从鲫鱼肠道中分离出的鲸杆菌属无细胞培养上清液具有清除DPPH、羟基自由基和超氧阴离子等功能，并增强斑马鱼对嗜水气单胞菌感染的抵抗力。
text_en: It is reported that cell-free culture supernatant of Cetobacterium isolated from the intestine of crucian carp has functions such as scavenging DPPH, hydroxyl radicals and superoxide anions, and enhances the resistance of zebrafish to Aeromonas hydrophila infection.

quote: Meanwhile, studies have shown that carvacrol can, to a certain extent, enhance immune indicators such as myeloperoxidase activity and phagocytic activity in fish [ 33 ], thereby strengthening immune barrier function and boosting the host’s resistance to potential pathogenic bacteria.
statement: 研究表明香芹酚能在一定程度上增强鱼类髓过氧化物酶活性和吞噬活性等免疫指标，从而加强免疫屏障功能并提高宿主对潜在致病菌的抵抗力。
text_zh: 研究表明香芹酚能在一定程度上增强鱼类髓过氧化物酶活性和吞噬活性等免疫指标，从而加强免疫屏障功能并提高宿主对潜在致病菌的抵抗力。
text_en: Studies show that carvacrol can, to a certain extent, enhance immune indicators such as fish myeloperoxidase activity and phagocytic activity, thereby strengthening the immune barrier function and improving host resistance to potential pathogenic bacteria.

quote: The results of the Principal Component Analysis (PCA) indicated that carvacrol could affect the serum metabolites, with more pronounced changes observed in serum metabolites after pathogen challenge.
statement: 主成分分析结果表明香芹酚可以影响血清代谢物，且在病原体攻击后观察到的血清代谢物变化更为显著。
text_zh: 主成分分析结果表明香芹酚可以影响血清代谢物，且在病原体攻击后观察到的血清代谢物变化更为显著。
text_en: Principal component analysis results indicated that carvacrol can affect serum metabolites, and the changes in serum metabolites observed after pathogen attack were more significant.

quote: Compared with diploid (2n) fish, triploid (3n) fish often have superior phenotypic characteristics, such as an enhanced growth rate, lower mortality rate, and greater stress tolerance
statement: 与二倍体鱼相比，三倍体鱼通常具有生长速度更快、死亡率更低和应激耐受性更强等优越的表型特征。
text_zh: 与二倍体鱼相比，三倍体鱼通常具有生长速度更快、死亡率更低和应激耐受性更强等优越的表型特征。
text_en: Compared to diploid fish, triploid fish typically exhibit superior phenotypic characteristics such as faster growth rate, lower mortality, and stronger stress tolerance.
outcome: 生长性能、存活率及应激耐受性

quote: This strain has a number of enhanced traits, such as fast growth, good flesh quality, and sterility, which are beneficial to ecological security and large-scale farming
statement: 该品系具有快速生长、肉质好和不育等增强性状，有利于生态安全和大规模养殖。
text_zh: 该品系具有快速生长、肉质好和不育等增强性状，有利于生态安全和大规模养殖。
text_en: This strain has enhanced traits such as fast growth, good meat quality, and sterility, which are beneficial for ecological safety and large-scale aquaculture.
outcome: 生长性能、肉质品质及生态安全性

quote: Cadmium (Cd) is toxic to aquatic organisms, and it can have long-term adverse effects on the aquatic environment
statement: 镉对水生生物有毒，并可能对水环境产生长期的不利影响。
text_zh: 镉对水生生物有毒，并可能对水环境产生长期的不利影响。
text_en: Cadmium is toxic to aquatic organisms and may have long-term adverse effects on the water environment.

quote: Fish were cultured in aerated water at 22°C without feeding for 1 week.
statement: 鱼在22°C充氧水中饲养一周且不喂食。
text_zh: 鱼在22°C充氧水中饲养一周且不喂食。
text_en: Fish were kept in oxygenated water at 22°C for one week without feeding.

population.species: C. auratus red var. (2n fish) and Xiangyunji fish (3n fish)

quote: In this study, each group consisted of seven fish cultured in a plastic tank containing ∼150 L of water.
statement: 本研究中每组由七条鱼组成，饲养在含有约150升水的塑料箱中。
text_zh: 本研究中每组由七条鱼组成，饲养在含有约150升水的塑料箱中。
text_en: In this study, each group consisted of seven fish housed in plastic boxes containing about 150 liters of water.

population.species: C. auratus red var. (2n fish) and Xiangyunji fish (3n fish)

quote: Fish were not fed, and dead fish were counted and promptly removed.
statement: 鱼不喂食，死亡鱼被计数并立即移除。
text_zh: 鱼不喂食，死亡鱼被计数并立即移除。
text_en: Fish were not fed, dead fish were counted and immediately removed.

population.species: C. auratus red var. (2n fish) and Xiangyunji fish (3n fish)

quote: Fish were anesthetized with 100 mg/L of MS-222 (Sigma–Aldrich Co., Ltd., Shanghai, China) before dissection.
statement: 解剖前使用100 mg/L的MS-222对鱼进行麻醉。
text_zh: 解剖前使用100 mg/L的MS-222对鱼进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized with 100 mg/L of MS-222 before dissection.

population.species: C. auratus red var. (2n fish) and Xiangyunji fish (3n fish)

quote: In grass carp, Feng et al. (2004) found that parts of hepatocytes were lytic and necrotic after Cd poisoning, and the AST and ALP activities in blood plasma of experimental groups were significantly higher than those in the corresponding control group, whereas the TP level was significantly lower.
statement: Feng等人（2004）发现，草鱼在镉中毒后部分肝细胞发生溶解和坏死，实验组血浆中AST和ALP活性显著高于对照组，而TP水平显著降低。
text_zh: Feng等人（2004）发现，草鱼在镉中毒后部分肝细胞发生溶解和坏死，实验组血浆中AST和ALP活性显著高于对照组，而TP水平显著降低。
text_en: Feng et al. (2004) found that after cadmium poisoning, some hepatocytes in grass carp underwent lysis and necrosis; plasma AST and ALP activities in the experimental group were significantly higher than those in the control group, while TP levels were significantly lower.
outcome: 肝脏组织损伤及血液生化指标变化

quote: MDA content (reported as nmol/g tissue) was calculated by 5 × [6.45 × (A532-A600)−1.29 × A450]/0.1, where A450, A532, and A600 represented the absorbance of each sample at 450, 532, and 600 nm, respectively.
statement: 丙二醛（MDA）含量通过特定公式根据450、532和600纳米处的吸光度计算得出。
text_zh: 丙二醛（MDA）含量通过特定公式根据450、532和600纳米处的吸光度计算得出。
text_en: Malondialdehyde (MDA) content was calculated using a specific formula based on absorbance at 450, 532, and 600 nanometers.

quote: Exposure to 9 mg/L Cd for 96 h changed the hepatic function indexes remarkably in the 2n fish, but not in the 3n fish.
statement: 暴露于9 mg/L的镉中96小时显著改变了二倍体鱼的肝功能指标，但在三倍体鱼中没有改变。
text_zh: 暴露于9 mg/L的镉中96小时显著改变了二倍体鱼的肝功能指标，但在三倍体鱼中没有改变。
text_en: Exposure to 9 mg/L of cadmium for 96 hours significantly changed liver function indicators in diploid fish, but not in triploid fish.

quote: In the serum of Cd-treated 2n fish, the levels of alanine amino transferase, aspartate aminotransferase, adenosine deaminase, and total bilirubin significantly increased, while the levels of total protein, albumin, lysozyme, and anti-superoxide anion radicals decreased demonstrating hepatotoxicity.
statement: 在经镉处理的二倍体鱼血清中，丙氨酸氨基转移酶、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶、腺苷脱氨酶和总胆红素水平显著升高，而总蛋白、白蛋白、溶菌酶和抗超氧阴离子自由基水平降低，表明存在肝毒性。
text_zh: 在经镉处理的二倍体鱼血清中，丙氨酸氨基转移酶、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶、腺苷脱氨酶和总胆红素水平显著升高，而总蛋白、白蛋白、溶菌酶和抗超氧阴离子自由基水平降低，表明存在肝毒性。
text_en: In the serum of diploid fish treated with cadmium, alanine aminotransferase, aspartate aminotransferase, adenosine deaminase, and total bilirubin levels increased significantly, while total protein, albumin, lysozyme, and anti-superoxide anion radical levels decreased, indicating hepatotoxicity.
outcome: 肝脏毒性/免疫因子水平

quote: By analysis of transcriptome profiles, many immune-related pathways were found to be involved in the response of 3n fish to the Cd-induced stress.
statement: 通过转录组谱分析，发现许多免疫相关通路参与了三倍体鱼对镉诱导应激的反应。
text_zh: 通过转录组谱分析，发现许多免疫相关通路参与了三倍体鱼对镉诱导应激的反应。
text_en: Transcriptome profiling revealed that many immune-related pathways were involved in the response of triploid fish to cadmium-induced stress.

quote: Expression levels of the immune genes, including the interleukin genes, tumor necrosis factor super family member genes, chemokine gene, toll-like receptor gene, and inflammatory marker cyclooxygenase 2 gene were significantly enhanced in the hepatopancreas of the Cd-treated 3n fish.
statement: 在经镉处理的三倍体鱼的肝胰腺中，包括白细胞介素基因、肿瘤坏死因子超家族成员基因、趋化因子基因、Toll样受体基因和炎症标志物环氧合酶2基因在内的免疫基因表达水平显著增强。
text_zh: 在经镉处理的三倍体鱼的肝胰腺中，包括白细胞介素基因、肿瘤坏死因子超家族成员基因、趋化因子基因、Toll样受体基因和炎症标志物环氧合酶2基因在内的免疫基因表达水平显著增强。
text_en: In the hepatopancreas of triploid fish treated with cadmium, the expression levels of immune genes, including interleukin genes, tumor necrosis factor superfamily member genes, chemokine genes, Toll-like receptor genes, and the inflammatory marker cyclooxygenase-2 gene, were significantly increased.

quote: scriptome analysis showed that immunity-related genes were involved in the response of crucian carp to Cd stress.
statement: 转录组分析表明，免疫相关基因参与了鲫鱼对镉胁迫的响应。
text_zh: 转录组分析表明，免疫相关基因参与了鲫鱼对镉胁迫的响应。
text_en: Transcriptome analysis indicated that immune-related genes were involved in the response of crucian carp to cadmium stress.

quote: These results helped explain why triploidy improved the resistance of fish to Cd stress, and can provide an important theoretical basis for polyploid fish breeding and the ecological restoration of polluted water.
statement: 这些结果有助于解释为什么三倍体提高了鱼对镉胁迫的抵抗力，并为多倍体鱼类育种和污染水体的生态修复提供了重要的理论基础。
text_zh: 这些结果有助于解释为什么三倍体提高了鱼对镉胁迫的抵抗力，并为多倍体鱼类育种和污染水体的生态修复提供了重要的理论基础。
text_en: These results help explain why triploidy improves fish resistance to cadmium stress, and provide an important theoretical basis for polyploid fish breeding and ecological restoration of polluted water bodies.

quote: Many important immune factors were significantly upregulated in the hepatopancreas of 3n fish after Cd treatment compared with their control group, such as signal transducers (tlr4, jun, junb, fos, creb5, par2), cytokines and cytokine receptors (il6, tnfrsf5, tnfrsf13 , tnfsf10, tnfsf12), chemokines and chemokine receptors (ccr9, ccl4, cxcr4, cxcr3), heat shock proteins (hsp70, hsp90a), and the inflammatory inducible enzyme (cox2) (Table 3).
statement: 与对照组相比，镉处理后的三倍体鱼肝胰腺中许多重要免疫因子（如信号转导子、细胞因子及其受体、趋化因子及其受体、热休克蛋白和炎症诱导酶）显著上调。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，镉处理后的三倍体鱼肝胰腺中许多重要免疫因子（如信号转导子、细胞因子及其受体、趋化因子及其受体、热休克蛋白和炎症诱导酶）显著上调。
text_en: Compared with the control group, many important immune factors (such as signal transducers, cytokines and their receptors, chemokines and their receptors, heat shock proteins, and inflammation-inducing enzymes) were significantly upregulated in the hepatopancreas of triploid fish after cadmium treatment.

quote: We found that the content of MDA increased significantly in Cd-exposed 2n C. auratus red var . but not in 3n crucian carp (Figure 1).
statement: 研究发现，在镉暴露下，二倍体红鲫的MDA含量显著增加，而三倍体鲫鱼未发生此变化。
text_zh: 研究发现，在镉暴露下，二倍体红鲫的MDA含量显著增加，而三倍体鲫鱼未发生此变化。
text_en: The study found that under cadmium exposure, MDA content significantly increased in diploid red crucian carp, while this change did not occur in triploid crucian carp.

population.species: C. auratus red var.; 3n crucian carp

counterevidence: 三倍体鲫鱼未表现出MDA含量的显著增加

quote: The Cd exposure resulted in significant decreases in levels of serum LZM and ASOR in C. auratus red var . relative to their control, but no significant change in 3n crucian carp was detected (Figure 2).
statement: 镉暴露导致红鲫血清中溶菌酶（LZM）和抗补体溶血活性（ASOR）水平相对于对照组显著下降，但在三倍体鲫鱼中未检测到显著变化。
text_zh: 镉暴露导致红鲫血清中溶菌酶（LZM）和抗补体溶血活性（ASOR）水平相对于对照组显著下降，但在三倍体鲫鱼中未检测到显著变化。
text_en: Cadmium exposure caused a significant decrease in lysozyme (LZM) and anticomplementary hemolytic activity (ASOR) levels in the serum of red crucian carp relative to the control group, but no significant changes were detected in triploid crucian carp.

population.species: C. auratus red var.; 3n crucian carp

counterevidence: 三倍体鲫鱼未表现出免疫指标的显著下降

quote: Therefore, our results suggested that Cd exposure caused excessive oxidative stress in 2n but not in 3n crucian carp.
statement: 因此，研究结果表明镉暴露在二倍体鲫鱼中引起了过度的氧化应激，而在三倍体鲫鱼中没有引起。
text_zh: 因此，研究结果表明镉暴露在二倍体鲫鱼中引起了过度的氧化应激，而在三倍体鲫鱼中没有引起。
text_en: Therefore, the results indicate that cadmium exposure caused excessive oxidative stress in diploid crucian carp but not in triploid crucian carp.
outcome: 氧化应激与多倍体耐受性
counterevidence: 三倍体鲫鱼对镉诱导的氧化应激表现出不同的反应

quote: The qRT-PCR analysis revealed significant differences in gene expression levels between 2n and 3n fish under Cd stress.
statement: qRT-PCR分析显示，在镉胁迫下，二倍体和三倍体鲫鱼的基因表达水平存在显著差异。
text_zh: qRT-PCR分析显示，在镉胁迫下，二倍体和三倍体鲫鱼的基因表达水平存在显著差异。
text_en: qRT-PCR analysis showed that there were significant differences in gene expression levels between diploid and triploid crucian carp under cadmium stress.

quote: In the Cd-treated 3n fish, the mRNA expression levels of all nine genes were upregulated relative to the control (Figures 4B–J).
statement: 在经镉处理的三倍体鱼中，相对于对照组，所有九个基因的mRNA表达水平均上调。
text_zh: 在经镉处理的三倍体鱼中，相对于对照组，所有九个基因的mRNA表达水平均上调。
text_en: In cadmium-treated triploid fish, the mRNA expression levels of all nine genes were upregulated relative to the control group.

quote: Before Cd exposure, the MDA level in the hepatopancreas tissue did not differ significantly between the 2n and 3n fish.
statement: 在镉暴露之前，二倍体和三倍体鱼肝胰腺组织中的MDA水平没有显著差异。
text_zh: 在镉暴露之前，二倍体和三倍体鱼肝胰腺组织中的MDA水平没有显著差异。
text_en: Before cadmium exposure, there was no significant difference in MDA levels in the hepatopancreas tissue of diploid and triploid fish.

population.species: C. auratus red var. (2n) and triploid crucian carp (3n)

outcome: 氧化应激指标（MDA）基线水平

quote: After Cd exposure, the MDA content was significantly higher (p p > 0.05). The MDA content of Cd-treated 2n fish was 1.80 times higher than that of Cd-treated 3n fish (Figure 1).
statement: 镉暴露后，MDA含量显著升高；经镉处理的二倍体鱼的MDA含量是三倍体鱼的1.80倍。
text_zh: 镉暴露后，MDA含量显著升高；经镉处理的二倍体鱼的MDA含量是三倍体鱼的1.80倍。
text_en: After cadmium exposure, MDA content increased significantly; the MDA content of diploid fish treated with cadmium was 1.80 times that of triploid fish.

population.species: C. auratus red var. (2n) and triploid crucian carp (3n)

counterevidence: 二倍体比三倍体遭受更严重的脂质过氧化损伤

quote: Prior to Cd exposure, the serum LZM level did not differ between the 2n and 3n fish.
statement: 在镉暴露之前，二倍体和三倍体鱼的血清溶菌酶（LZM）水平没有差异。
text_zh: 在镉暴露之前，二倍体和三倍体鱼的血清溶菌酶（LZM）水平没有差异。
text_en: Before cadmium exposure, there was no difference in serum lysozyme (LZM) levels between diploid and triploid fish.

population.species: C. auratus red var. (2n) and triploid crucian carp (3n)

quote: Under Cd stress, however, the LZM content was significantly decreased in 2n fish relative to their control (p p > 0.05) (Figure 2A).
statement: 在镉胁迫下，二倍体鱼的血清LZM含量相对于其对照组显著降低。
text_zh: 在镉胁迫下，二倍体鱼的血清LZM含量相对于其对照组显著降低。
text_en: Under cadmium stress, the serum LZM content of diploid fish was significantly lower than that of their control group.
outcome: 非特异性免疫功能受损
counterevidence: 镉导致二倍体鱼免疫活性物质减少

quote: The level of LZM in the Cd-treated 3n fish was 2.33 times higher than that in the Cd-treated 2n fish.
statement: 经镉处理的三倍体鱼的血清LZM水平是经镉处理的二倍体鱼的2.33倍。
text_zh: 经镉处理的三倍体鱼的血清LZM水平是经镉处理的二倍体鱼的2.33倍。
text_en: The serum LZM level of cadmium-treated triploid fish was 2.33 times that of cadmium-treated diploid fish.

population.species: triploid crucian carp (3n) vs C. auratus red var. (2n)

outcome: 免疫耐受性或抵抗力差异

quote: In this study, the triploid crucian carp has been used as experimental materials and it was found that improved resistance to cadmium stress in triploid crucian carp can be the result of enhanced immune activity.
statement: 本研究发现，三倍体鲫鱼对镉胁迫的抵抗力增强可能是免疫活性增强的结果。
text_zh: 本研究发现，三倍体鲫鱼对镉胁迫的抵抗力增强可能是免疫活性增强的结果。
text_en: This study found that the enhanced resistance of triploid crucian carp to cadmium stress may be a result of increased immune activity.
outcome: 抗应激能力与免疫功能

quote: Our results confirmed that hepatopancreas functionality is the main target of Cd toxicity in fish and that 2n C. auratus red var. were more sensitive to Cd stress than 3n crucian carp.
statement: 研究结果证实，肝胰腺功能是鱼类镉毒性的主要靶点，且二倍体红鲫比三倍体鲫鱼对镉胁迫更敏感。
text_zh: 研究结果证实，肝胰腺功能是鱼类镉毒性的主要靶点，且二倍体红鲫比三倍体鲫鱼对镉胁迫更敏感。
text_en: The results confirmed that hepatopancreas function is the main target of cadmium toxicity in fish, and diploid red crucian carp are more sensitive to cadmium stress than triploid crucian carp.

population.species: C. auratus red var.; crucian carp

outcome: 器官功能与毒性敏感性

quote: Effects of curcumin on haematological values, immunity, antioxidant status and resistance of rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) against Aeromonas salmonicida subsp. achromogenes.
statement: 姜黄素对虹鳟血液学指标、免疫、抗氧化状态及抗杀鲑气单胞菌亚种无色变株的能力有影响。
text_zh: 姜黄素对虹鳟血液学指标、免疫、抗氧化状态及抗杀鲑气单胞菌亚种无色变株的能力有影响。
text_en: Curcumin affects the hematological parameters, immunity, antioxidant status, and resistance to Aeromonas salmonicida subsp. achromogenes in rainbow trout.

quote: The effect of experimental cadmium poisoning on hepatopancreas, kidney, skeleton in Ctenopharyngodon idella .
statement: 实验性镉中毒对草鱼肝胰腺、肾脏和骨骼的影响。
text_zh: 实验性镉中毒对草鱼肝胰腺、肾脏和骨骼的影响。
text_en: Effects of experimental cadmium poisoning on the hepatopancreas, kidney, and skeleton of grass carp.

quote: In comparison with the 2n control group, some hepatopancreas function indices changed significantly after 2n fish were exposed to Cd.
statement: 与2n对照组相比，2n鱼暴露于镉后，一些肝胰腺功能指数发生显著变化。
text_zh: 与2n对照组相比，2n鱼暴露于镉后，一些肝胰腺功能指数发生显著变化。
text_en: Compared to the 2n control group, some hepatopancreas function indices changed significantly in 2n fish after exposure to cadmium.

quote: The activities of ALT, AST, and ADA, and the T-Bil content increased by 99, 157, 197, and 111%, respectively (Table 2).
statement: 2n鱼暴露于镉后，ALT、AST和ADA活性以及T-Bil含量分别增加了99%、157%、197%和111%。
text_zh: 2n鱼暴露于镉后，ALT、AST和ADA活性以及T-Bil含量分别增加了99%、157%、197%和111%。
text_en: After exposure to cadmium, ALT, AST and ADA activities and T-Bil content in 2n fish increased by 99%, 157%, 197% and 111%, respectively.

quote: However, there was no obvious difference in most index levels between control and Cd-treated 3n fish.
statement: 然而，对照组和Cd处理组3n鱼之间大多数指标水平没有明显差异。
text_zh: 然而，对照组和Cd处理组3n鱼之间大多数指标水平没有明显差异。
text_en: However, there was no significant difference in the levels of most indicators between the control group and the Cd-treated 3n fish.

quote: The exceptions were ALT and ADA activities, which decreased by 31 and 61%, respectively (Table 2).
statement: 例外的是ALT和ADA活性，它们分别下降了31%和61%。
text_zh: 例外的是ALT和ADA活性，它们分别下降了31%和61%。
text_en: The exceptions were ALT and ADA activities, which decreased by 31% and 61%, respectively.

quote: The activities of AST, ALP, and ADA, and the T-Bil content in the Cd-treated 2n fish were about 4.62, 1.74, 6.93, and 1.61 times higher than those of the Cd-treated 3n fish.
statement: Cd处理的2n鱼中AST、ALP和ADA活性以及T-Bil含量约为Cd处理的3n鱼的4.62、1.74、6.93和1.61倍。
text_zh: Cd处理的2n鱼中AST、ALP和ADA活性以及T-Bil含量约为Cd处理的3n鱼的4.62、1.74、6.93和1.61倍。
text_en: In Cd-treated 2n fish, the activities of AST, ALP and ADA and the T-Bil content were about 4.62, 1.74, 6.93 and 1.61 times those in Cd-treated 3n fish.

quote: In contrast, the levels of TP and ALB in the Cd-treated 3n fish were 1.49 and 2.42 times higher than those in the Cd-treated 2n fish.
statement: 相反，Cd处理的3n鱼中TP和ALB水平比Cd处理的2n鱼高1.49和2.42倍。
text_zh: 相反，Cd处理的3n鱼中TP和ALB水平比Cd处理的2n鱼高1.49和2.42倍。
text_en: Conversely, TP and ALB levels in Cd-treated 3n fish were 1.49 and 2.42 times higher than those in Cd-treated 2n fish.

quote: Baldissera et al. (2018b) proposed that downregulation of serum ADA activity exerted an anti-inflammatory effect that contributed to restricting the inflammatory process in silver catfish.
statement: Baldissera等人（2018b）提出，血清ADA活性的下调产生了抗炎作用，有助于限制银鲶鱼的炎症过程。
text_zh: Baldissera等人（2018b）提出，血清ADA活性的下调产生了抗炎作用，有助于限制银鲶鱼的炎症过程。
text_en: Baldissera et al. (2018b) proposed that the downregulation of serum ADA activity produced an anti-inflammatory effect, helping to limit the inflammatory process in silver catfish.

quote: Our results also indicated that Cd exposure led to acute damage to the hepatopancreas in 2n C. auratus red var .
statement: 本研究结果表明，镉暴露导致二倍体红鲫（2n C. auratus red var.）的肝胰腺受到急性损伤。
text_zh: 本研究结果表明，镉暴露导致二倍体红鲫（2n C. auratus red var.）的肝胰腺受到急性损伤。
text_en: The results of this study indicate that cadmium exposure caused acute damage to the hepatopancreas of diploid red crucian carp (2n C. auratus red var.).

quote: Thus, we concluded that 2n C. auratus red var . was more vulnerable to Cd exposure than 3n crucian carp based on the hepatopancreas function indices.
statement: 因此，基于肝胰腺功能指标，我们得出结论：二倍体红鲫比三倍体鲫鱼对镉暴露更敏感。
text_zh: 因此，基于肝胰腺功能指标，我们得出结论：二倍体红鲫比三倍体鲫鱼对镉暴露更敏感。
text_en: Therefore, based on hepatopancreas function indicators, we conclude that diploid red crucian carp are more sensitive to cadmium exposure than triploid crucian carp.

population.species: 2n C. auratus red var.; 3n crucian carp

outcome: 物种对镉毒性的敏感性差异

quote: Increased production of MDA reflects the degree of oxidative damage in the body (Shi et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2019 ; Gu et al., 2020).
statement: MDA产量的增加反映了体内氧化损伤的程度。
text_zh: MDA产量的增加反映了体内氧化损伤的程度。
text_en: The increase in MDA production reflects the extent of oxidative damage in the body.

quote: In the hepatopancreas tissue of 3n crucian carp, Cd exposure significantly upregulated the expression of il1 β, il6, tnfsf12, tnfrsf13 β, ccl4, tlr, hsp70, cox2, and fos (Figure 4).
statement: 在三倍体鲫鱼的肝胰腺组织中，镉暴露显著上调了il1β、il6、tnfsf12、tnfrsf13β、ccl4、tlr、hsp70、cox2和fos的表达。
text_zh: 在三倍体鲫鱼的肝胰腺组织中，镉暴露显著上调了il1β、il6、tnfsf12、tnfrsf13β、ccl4、tlr、hsp70、cox2和fos的表达。
text_en: In the hepatopancreas tissue of triploid crucian carp, cadmium exposure significantly upregulated the expression of il1β, il6, tnfsf12, tnfrsf13β, ccl4, tlr, hsp70, cox2 and fos.

quote: Parsons et al. (1986) found that 3n rainbow trout × coho salmon hybrids showed increased resistance to infectious hematopoietic necrosis virus,
statement: Parsons等人（1986年）发现，三倍体虹鳟×银鲑杂交后代对传染性造血器官坏死病毒表现出增加的抵抗力。
text_zh: Parsons等人（1986年）发现，三倍体虹鳟×银鲑杂交后代对传染性造血器官坏死病毒表现出增加的抵抗力。
text_en: Parsons et al. (1986) found that triploid rainbow trout × coho salmon hybrid offspring exhibited increased resistance to infectious hematopoietic necrosis virus.

quote: In the hepatopancreas tissue of 3n fish, we found 658 genes that were differentially expressed between the control and Cd-treated groups, of which 301 were upregulated and 357 were downregulated
statement: 在三倍体鱼的肝胰腺组织中，对照组和镉处理组之间发现了658个差异表达基因，其中301个上调，357个下调。
text_zh: 在三倍体鱼的肝胰腺组织中，对照组和镉处理组之间发现了658个差异表达基因，其中301个上调，357个下调。
text_en: In the hepatopancreas tissue of triploid fish, 658 differentially expressed genes were found between the control group and the cadmium-treated group, with 301 upregulated and 357 downregulated.

quote: Moreover, 437 immune-related DEGs were significant, with 224 upregulated and 213 downregulated genes.
statement: 此外，有437个免疫相关的差异表达基因具有显著性，其中224个基因上调，213个基因下调。
text_zh: 此外，有437个免疫相关的差异表达基因具有显著性，其中224个基因上调，213个基因下调。
text_en: In addition, there were 437 significantly differentially expressed immune-related genes, of which 224 genes were upregulated and 213 genes were downregulated.

quote: The immune response, inflammatory response, and apoptosis were the main Gene Ontology (GO) items that were enriched
statement: 免疫反应、炎症反应和细胞凋亡是主要富集的基因本体（GO）条目。
text_zh: 免疫反应、炎症反应和细胞凋亡是主要富集的基因本体（GO）条目。
text_en: Immune response, inflammatory response, and apoptosis are the main enriched Gene Ontology (GO) terms.

quote: Serum adenosine deaminase and xanthine oxidase activities in silver catfish naturally infected with Ichthyophthirius multifiliis : the influence of these enzymes on inflammatory and oxidative status.
statement: 血清腺苷脱氨酶和黄嘌呤氧化酶活性影响自然感染多子小瓜虫的银鲶鱼的炎症和氧化状态。
text_zh: 血清腺苷脱氨酶和黄嘌呤氧化酶活性影响自然感染多子小瓜虫的银鲶鱼的炎症和氧化状态。
text_en: Serum adenosine deaminase and xanthine oxidase activities affect the inflammation and oxidative status of silver catfish naturally infected with Ichthyophthirius multifiliis.

quote: Immuno-physiological and antioxidant responses of Siberian sturgeon (Acipenser baerii) fed with different levels of olive pomace.
statement: 饲喂不同水平橄榄渣的西伯利亚鲟表现出免疫生理和抗氧化反应。
text_zh: 饲喂不同水平橄榄渣的西伯利亚鲟表现出免疫生理和抗氧化反应。
text_en: Siberian sturgeon fed different levels of olive pomace exhibited immune physiological and antioxidant responses.
outcome: 免疫生理和抗氧化反应

quote: The immune system is limited by oxidative stress: dietary selenium promotes optimal antioxidative status and greatest immune defense in pacu Piaractus mesopotamicus .
statement: 膳食硒促进Piaractus mesopotamicus的最佳抗氧化状态和最大的免疫防御，因为免疫系统受氧化应激限制。
text_zh: 膳食硒促进Piaractus mesopotamicus的最佳抗氧化状态和最大的免疫防御，因为免疫系统受氧化应激限制。
text_en: Dietary selenium promotes the optimal antioxidant status and maximum immune defense of Piaractus mesopotamicus, because the immune system is limited by oxidative stress.
outcome: 抗氧化状态和免疫防御

quote: Differential effect of waterborne cadmium exposure on lipid metabolism in
statement: 水溶性镉暴露对脂质代谢有不同的影响。
text_zh: 水溶性镉暴露对脂质代谢有不同的影响。
text_en: Water-soluble cadmium exposure has different effects on lipid metabolism.

quote: To further compare the effects of eugenol on the tissues of crucian carp, we examined the histological changes in the gills and liver after 10 min of eugenol anesthesia.
statement: 为了比较丁香酚对鲫鱼组织的影响，研究人员检查了经过10分钟丁香酚麻醉后鳃和肝脏的组织学变化。
text_zh: 为了比较丁香酚对鲫鱼组织的影响，研究人员检查了经过10分钟丁香酚麻醉后鳃和肝脏的组织学变化。
text_en: To compare the effects of eugenol on crucian carp tissues, researchers examined histological changes in gills and liver after 10 minutes of eugenol anesthesia.

quote: The red blood cells and platelets of crucian carp decreased significantly (p p p p p p > 0.05).
statement: 丁香酚麻醉导致鲫鱼红细胞和血小板显著减少。
text_zh: 丁香酚麻醉导致鲫鱼红细胞和血小板显著减少。
text_en: Eugenol anesthesia caused a significant decrease in red blood cells and platelets in crucian carp.

quote: No significant difference was observed in muscle glycogen and liver glycogen content after eugenol anesthesia (p > 0.05).
statement: 丁香酚麻醉后，肌肉糖原和肝脏糖原含量无显著差异。
text_zh: 丁香酚麻醉后，肌肉糖原和肝脏糖原含量无显著差异。
text_en: After eugenol anesthesia, there was no significant difference in muscle glycogen and liver glycogen content.

quote: The eugenol-based anesthesia test did not indicate major liver histomorphological effects, but the very small number of gill sheet edema cases observed requires further study.
statement: 基于丁香酚的麻醉测试未显示主要的肝脏组织形态学影响，但观察到极少量的鳃丝水肿病例需要进一步研究。
text_zh: 基于丁香酚的麻醉测试未显示主要的肝脏组织形态学影响，但观察到极少量的鳃丝水肿病例需要进一步研究。
text_en: Eugenol-based anesthesia tests did not show major histomorphological effects on the liver, but a very small number of cases of gill filament edema were observed and require further study.
limitations: 样本量或观察到的病例极少

quote: After eugenol anesthesia, the RBC concentration in each experimental group was lower than that in the control group (Figure 1 A).
statement: 丁香酚麻醉后，各实验组的红细胞浓度均低于对照组。
text_zh: 丁香酚麻醉后，各实验组的红细胞浓度均低于对照组。
text_en: After eugenol anesthesia, the red blood cell concentration in all experimental groups was lower than that in the control group.

quote: The PLT content was lower in each experimental group (p 9 /L; Figure 1 C).
statement: 各实验组的血小板含量较低。
text_zh: 各实验组的血小板含量较低。
text_en: The platelet content was lower in each experimental group.

quote: After eugenol anesthesia, the concentration of LDH in each experimental group was higher than that in the control group (Figure 2 A).
statement: 丁香酚麻醉后，各实验组的乳酸脱氢酶浓度均高于对照组。
text_zh: 丁香酚麻醉后，各实验组的乳酸脱氢酶浓度均高于对照组。
text_en: After eugenol anesthesia, the lactate dehydrogenase concentrations in all experimental groups were higher than those in the control group.
outcome: 血清酶指标（乳酸脱氢酶浓度）

quote: The fish were temporarily cultured at the National Agricultural Products Modern Logistics Engineering Technology Research Center with an aquatic product temperature control circulating water filtration system.
statement: Fish were temporarily cultured using a temperature-controlled circulating water filtration system.
text_en: Fish were temporarily cultured using a temperature-controlled circulating water filtration system.
